ar: وَهُوَ الَلَّهُ فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ
en: And He is Allah in the heavens and in the earth
There is no God but He

ar: هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَجِيدٌ فِي لَوْحٍ مَحْفُوظٍ
tr: huwa qur'aanun majeedun fi lawhin mahfoodhin
en: It is a glorious Quran in a Preserved Tablet

ar: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَاضِيَةٍ فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
tr: fa huwa fi 'eeshatin raadiyatin fi jannatin 'aaliyatin
en: so he will be in a pleasing life in a lofty garden

ar: الَلَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
tr: Allaahu khaaliquh kulli shay'in wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in wakeelun
en: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is over all things Disposer of affairs

ar: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا أَمْرُ الَسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِنَّ الَلَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tr: wa lillaahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ardhi wa maa amrus-saa'ati illaa kalamhil-basari aw huwa aqrabu innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeerun
en: And to Allah belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth. And the matter of the Hour is not but as a twinkling of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

ar: مِنَ الَلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ / وَجِهَادٍ فِي سَبِيلِهِ
en: from Allah and His Messenger and striving in His path
then only his account / (is) with his Lord
so he / (is) upon a light / from his Lord
and for Allah (is) the honor and for His Messenger
is / upon clear evidence / from his Lord
then for his mother / (is) the third
his harm / (is) closer than his benefit
that Salih / (is) sent from his Lord
and the stars (are) subjected by His command
(there is) no changer / for His words
and indeed / from his party / (was) Ibrahim
in His hand (is the) dominion (of) every thing
indeed mankind / to his Lord / (is) surely ungrateful
and Shaitan is / to his Lord ungrateful
and from behind him / (is) a severe punishment
and the disbeliever is / against his Lord a helper
a disassociation from Allah and His Messenger
and an announcement / from Allah and His Messenger

ar: بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ / وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tr: biyadihi al-mulku / wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeerun
en: in His hand (is) the dominion / and He (is) over all things All-Powerful

ar: فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
tr: fa-subhaana alladhee biyadihi malakootu kulli shay'in
en: so exalted is He in whose hand (is the) dominion (of) every thing

ar: لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِهِ / وَهُوَ الَسَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
tr: laa mubaddila likalimaatihi / wahuwa as-samee'u al-'aleemu
en: no changer for His words / and He (is) the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing
and among His signs / (is the) creation (of) the heavens and the earth

ar: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ / الَلَّيْلُ وَالَنَّهَارُ وَالَشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ
tr: wa-min aayaatihi / al-laylu wan-nahaaru wash-shamsu wal-qamaru
en: and among His signs / (are) the night and the day and the sun and the moon
rather, man / against himself / (will be) a witness

ar: هَذَا مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ / وَهَذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ
en: this (is) from his party / and this (is) from his enemy

ar: لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِ / وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
tr: laa mu'aqqiba lihukmihi / wahuwa saree'u al-hisaabi
en: none can repel His command / and He (is) swift (in) taking account

ar: وَالَنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَاتٌ بِأَمْرِهِ / إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ
tr: wan-nujoomu musakhkharaatun bi'amrihi / inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin
en: and the stars (are) subjected by His command / indeed in that (are) signs

ar: وَأَذَانٌ / مِنَ الَلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ / إِلَى الَنَّاسِ / يَوْمَ الْحَجِّ الْأَكْبَرِ / أَنَّ الَلَّهَ بَرِيءٌ
tr: wa-adhaanun / minallahi wa-rasoolihi / ilaa an-naasi / yawma al-hajji al-akbari / anna allaha baree'un
en: and an announcement / from Allah and His Messenger / to the people / (on the) day (of) the greatest pilgrimage / that Allah is free (from obligations)
and indeed he in the Hereafter

ar: إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ / لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ

to Him (belongs) the creation and the command

ar: لَهُ / مَا فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ

in it (is) severe strength and benefits for mankind

ar: وَلَهُ / الْمَثَلُ الْأَعْلَى / فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
en: and to Him (belongs) / the highest attribute / in the heavens and the earth

ar: لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ / مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

en: no doubt in it / from the Lord (of) the worlds

ar: لَيْسَ لَهُ / دَعْوَةٌ فِي الَدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ

en: Indeed your Lord / is possessor of forgiveness / and possessor of painful penalty

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ الْعِقَابِ / وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ

en: Indeed your Lord is swift in penalty / and indeed He is Forgiving and Merciful

ar: يَا نُوحُ / إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ / إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ
tr: yaa noohu / innahu laysa min ahlika / innahu 'amalun ghayru saalih
en: O Noah / indeed he is not of your family / indeed it is a deed not righteous
And the enduring good deeds are better with your Lord

ar: وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا / عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ / كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ
en: And indeed a day / with your Lord / is like a thousand years
And this is the path of your Lord

en: And indeed upon you is the curse until the Day of Judgment

tr: wa lal-aakhiratu / khayrun laka / mina l-oolaa
en: And the Hereafter / is better for you / than the first

ar: يَا آدَمُ إِنَّ هَذَا عَدُوٌّ لَكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ
tr: yaa aadamu inna haadhaa 'aduwwun laka wa lizawjika
en: O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife

ar: بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ / إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tr: biyadika l-khayru / innaka 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeerun
en: In Your hand is the good / indeed You are over all things competent

ar: إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ الَنَّاسِ / لِيَوْمٍ / لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ
tr: innaka jaami'u n-naasi / liyawmin / laa rayba feehi
en: Indeed You are the gatherer of the people / for a Day / about which there is no doubt

ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَى رَبِّكَ
tr: yaa ayyuhaa l-insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa rabbika
en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord

ar: أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى ثُمَّ أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى
tr: awlaa laka fa-awlaa thumma awlaa laka fa-awlaa
en: Woe to you and woe, then woe to you and woe

ar: إِنَّ لَكَ / فِي الَنَّهَارِ / سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
tr: inna laka / fee n-nahaari / sabhan taweelaa
en: Indeed for you / in the day / is prolonged occupation

Indeed you / are surely a clear deviant

And indeed for you is surely a reward / uninterrupted
And indeed it is surely a reminder for you and for your people

en: And indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of settlement
Peace it is until the emergence of dawn
Then indeed, Hellfire will be the refuge
Then indeed, Paradise will be the refuge
And the word of Allah - that is the highest
Its knowledge is only with Allah
Its fuel is people and stones
Its width is like the width of the heaven and the earth
Its width is the heavens and the earth
And the recompense of an evil is an evil like it
To your Lord is its end
Near it is the Garden of Refuge

ar: كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِي الَسَّمَاءِ
tr: kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluhaa thaabitun wa far'uhaa fis-samaa'
en: A good word is like a good tree, its root is firmly fixed and its branch is in the sky
for its time / at its appointed time

after its establishment / after its being firmly rooted
upon its back / on its surface

upon its roofs / collapsed on its trellises
upon its roots / on its stumps
a witness from her own family
in the earth after its reformation / after it has been set in order

He is taking hold of her forelock
Indeed its punishment is ever-lasting / a permanent affliction
She is older than her sister
and in its copy (tablet) is guidance and mercy
so it is fallen upon its roofs (collapsed)
and it is fallen upon its roofs (in ruins)
There is no denying its occurrence / None can belie its befalling
around her neck is a rope of palm fiber

ar: وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا
en: and it was doing wrong, so it is fallen upon its roofs (collapsed)
pleased with her striving, in a lofty garden

ar: وَامْرَأَتُهُ حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ فِي جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِنْ مَسَدٍ
tr: wa-mra'atuhu ḥammālata al-ḥaṭabi fī jīdihā ḥablun min masadin
en: and his wife, the carrier of firewood — around her neck is a rope of palm fiber

a wind in it (is) a painful punishment

No! Indeed it (is) a reminder | No! Indeed, it is a reminder
in it from all the fruits and forgiveness

ar: وَأَنَّ الَسَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا
tr: wa annas-saa'ata aatiyatun laa rayba feehaa
en: and that the Hour (is) coming, no doubt in it

ar: إِنَّ وَعْدَ الَلَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالَسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا
tr: inna wa'dallaahi haqqun was-saa'atu laa rayba feehaa
en: indeed the promise of Allah (is) true, and the Hour, no doubt in it

ar: أَنَّ وَعْدَ الَلَّهِ حَقٌّ وَأَنَّ الَسَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا
tr: anna wa'dallaahi haqqun wa annas-saa'ata laa rayba feehaa
en: that the promise of Allah (is) true and that the Hour, no doubt in it

ar: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُونِ الَلَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
en: not for it from besides Allah (is) any remover

ar: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُونِ الَلَّهِ وَلِيٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ
tr: laysa lahaa min doonillaahi waliyyun wa laa shafee'un
en: not for it from besides Allah (is) any protector and not any intercessor
its fuel (is) men and stones, over it (are) angels
indeed it (is) a yellow cow, bright (in) its color
I am Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise
I am only a messenger of your Lord

ar: إِنَّمَا الْآيَاتُ عِنْدَ الَلّٰهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

en: The signs are only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner

ar: إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ الَلّٰهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
tr: innama al-ilmu inda Allahi wa innama ana nadheerun mubeen
en: Knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner

ar: أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ
tr: ana khayrun min hadhal-ladhi huwa maheen
en: I am better than this one who is contemptible
And I alone am the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful
I alone am the clear warner
I alone am the Forgiving, the Merciful
And indeed upon you is my curse
This is my Lord, this is greater
I am Yusuf and this is my brother

tr: wa ana ajoozun / wa hadha ba'li
en: And I am an old woman and this is my husband

tr: anta waliyyi / fi ad-dunya wa al-akhirati
en: You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter
And indeed this is my straight path

ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الَدِّينِ
tr: wa inna alayka la'nati ila yawmi ad-deeni
en: And indeed upon you is my curse until the Day of Judgment
With me are the treasures of Allah
Indeed my Lord is with me
That is between me and you

ar: وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ / وَهٰذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا / إِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
tr: wa ana ajoozun / wa hadha ba'li shaykhan / inna hadha lashay'un ajeebun
en: And I am an old woman and this my husband is an old man. Indeed, this is an amazing thing

ar: يَا لَيْتَ / بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ / بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ
tr: ya layta / bayni wa baynaka / bu'da al-mashriqayni
en: Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance of the two easts

tr: wa ya qawmi / hadhihi naqatu Allahi
en: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah

ar: يَا قَوْمِ / إِنَّمَا هٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةُ الَدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ / وَإِنَّ الْآخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ
tr: ya qawmi / innama hadhihi al-hayatu ad-dunya mata'un / wa inna al-akhirata hiya daru al-qarari
en: O my people, this worldly life is only a temporary enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of permanent settlement
Indeed my Lord is near and responsive
Its knowledge is with my Lord
Indeed my son is of my family
Indeed my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful
Then indeed my Lord is Free of need and Generous
Indeed my Lord is Merciful and Loving
Indeed my Lord is surely Forgiving and Merciful
Indeed my Lord is the Hearer of supplication

ar: إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
en: Indeed my Lord is a Guardian over all things
Indeed my Lord is on a straight path
Its knowledge is with my Lord in a record
And that indeed my punishment is the painful punishment

ar: رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ
tr: Rabbi inna ibni min ahli wa inna wa'dakal haqq
en: My Lord! Indeed my son is of my family, and indeed Your promise is true

ar: إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ. لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
tr: Inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi rabbil 'alameen. La shareeka lah
en: Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner

Indeed I am migrating to my Lord
Indeed I am a guarding knower

Then indeed he is of me

There is not in me error

ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَنَّاسُ إِنِّي رَسُولُ الَلَّهِ
en: O mankind! Indeed I am a messenger of Allah

ar: يَا مُوسَى إِنِّي أَنَا الَلَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
en: O Musa! Indeed I, I am Allah, Lord of the worlds
O my people! Indeed I am free

ar: يَا قَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ
tr: Ya qawmi alaysa li mulku misr
en: O my people! Is not for me the kingdom of Egypt? | O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me?
Indeed I will make upon the earth a successive authority
Indeed I am on clear evidence from my Lord
This is a path to Me straight

tr: Wa akhi Haroonu huwa afsahu minni
en: And my brother Haroon, he is more eloquent than me

ar: يَا فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: Ya Fir'awnu inni rasoolun min rabbil 'alameen
en: O Firaun! Indeed I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

ar: يَا قَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي ضَلَالَةٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: Ya qawmi laysa bi dhalalatun wa lakinni rasoolun min rabbil 'alameen
en: O my people! There is not in me error, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

ar: يَا قَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي سَفَاهَةٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: Ya qawmi laysa bi safahatun wa lakinni rasoolun min rabbil 'alameen
en: O my people! There is not in me foolishness, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds
My Lord! Prison is more beloved to me
And indeed I am surely Forgiving
And indeed I am surely strong and trustworthy for it
Indeed for me with Him is surely the best
Indeed I, I am your brother
Indeed I, I am your Lord
O Musa! Indeed I, I am Allah
Indeed I, I am the clear warner
That indeed I, I am the Forgiving, the Merciful

ar: أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الَرَّحِيمُ. وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ
tr: Anni anal ghafoorur raheem. Wa anna 'athabi huwal 'athabul aleem
en: That indeed I, I am the Forgiving, the Merciful. And that indeed My punishment is the painful punishment
And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [true] life

Indeed, the righteous / will be within gardens and springs
Indeed, the righteous / will be in shades and springs
Indeed, the criminals / are in error and madness
Indeed, the wrongdoers / are in a lasting punishment

ar: وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ الَلَّهِ / وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
tr: watilka ḥudūdu Allāhi / walil-kāfirīna ʿadhābun alīm
en: And those are the limits of Allah / and for the disbelievers is a painful punishment

ar: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ / فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ / خَالِدُونَ
tr: inna al-mujrimīna / fī ʿadhābi jahannama / khālidūn
en: Indeed, the criminals / will be in the punishment of Hell / abiding eternally

ar: إِنَّ رَحْمَةَ الَلَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
tr: inna raḥmata Allāhi qarībun mina al-muḥsinīn
en: Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the good-doers

ar: إِنَّ الْخِزْيَ / الْيَوْمَ / وَالَسُّوءَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
tr: inna al-khizya / al-yawma / was-sūʾa ʿalā al-kāfirīn
en: Indeed, disgrace / this day / and evil are upon the disbelievers

ar: فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ / إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ
tr: fa-innaka mina al-munẓarīna / ilā yawmi al-waqti al-maʿlūm
en: So indeed, you are of those given respite / until the day of the time well-known

ar: ثُمَّ هُوَ / يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ / مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ
tr: thumma huwa / yawma al-qiyāmati / mina al-muḥḍarīn
en: Then he / on the Day of Resurrection / will be of those brought present
And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment

ar: هَذَا بَيَانٌ لِلنَّاسِ / وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةٌ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
tr: hādhā bayānun lin-nāsi / wahudan wamawʿiẓatun lil-muttaqīn
en: This is a declaration for the people / and guidance and advice for the righteous

ar: إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ / فِي الَدَّرْكِ الْأَسْفَلِ / مِنَ الَنَّارِ
tr: inna al-munāfiqīna / fī ad-darki al-asfali / mina an-nār
en: Indeed, the hypocrites / will be in the lowest depths / of the Fire

ar: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ / فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
tr: inna al-muttaqīna fī maqāmin amīnin / fī jannātin waʿuyūn
en: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place / within gardens and springs

ar: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَى وَعِيسَى وَإِلْيَاسَ / كُلٌّ مِنَ الَصَّالِحِينَ
tr: wa-zakariyyā wa-yaḥyā wa-ʿīsā wa-ilyāsa / kullun mina aṣ-ṣāliḥīn
en: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elijah / all were of the righteous

ar: ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ / وَقَلِيلٌ مِنَ الْآخِرِينَ
tr: thullatun mina al-awwalīna / waqalīlun mina al-ākharīn
en: A multitude of the former people / and a few of the later people

ar: فَذَلِكَ / يَوْمَئِذٍ / يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ / عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
tr: fadhālika / yawmaʾidhin / yawmun ʿasīrun / ʿalā al-kāfirīna ghayru yasīr
en: For that / that Day / will be a difficult day / for the disbelievers, not easy

ar: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ / هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ
tr: tilka āyātu al-kitābi al-ḥakīmi / hudan waraḥmatan lil-muḥsinīn
en: These are verses of the wise Book / as guidance and mercy for the good-doers

ar: لَقَدْ / كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِ آيَاتٌ / لِلسَّائِلِينَ
tr: laqad / kāna fī yūsufa wa-ikhwatihi āyātun / lis-sāʾilīn
en: Certainly / there were in Joseph and his brothers signs / for those who ask

ar: ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابُ / لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ / هُدًى لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
tr: dhālika al-kitābu / lā rayba fīhi / hudan lil-muttaqīn
en: That is the Book / about which there is no doubt / a guidance for the righteous

ar: الْخَبِيثَاتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ / وَالْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَاتِ / وَالَطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ / وَالَطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَاتِ
tr: al-khabīthātu lil-khabīthīna / wal-khabīthūna lil-khabīthāti / waṭ-ṭayyibātu liṭ-ṭayyibīna / waṭ-ṭayyibūna liṭ-ṭayyibāt
en: Evil women are for evil men / and evil men are for evil women / and pure women are for pure men / and pure men are for pure women

ar: مَنْ كَانَ عَدُوًّا / لِلَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَجِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَالَ / فَإِنَّ الَلَّهَ عَدُوٌّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ
tr: man kāna ʿaduwwan / lillāhi wamalāʾikatihī warusulihī wajibrīla wamīkāla / fa-inna Allāha ʿaduwwun lil-kāfirīn
en: Whoever is an enemy / to Allah and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael / then indeed, Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers

ar: وَأَذَانٌ مِنَ الَلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ / إِلَى الَنَّاسِ / يَوْمَ الْحَجِّ الْأَكْبَرِ / أَنَّ الَلَّهَ بَرِيءٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
tr: wa-adhānun mina Allāhi warasūlihī / ilā an-nāsi / yawma al-ḥajji al-akbari / anna Allāha barīʾun mina al-mushrikīn
en: And an announcement from Allah and His Messenger / to the people / on the day of the greater pilgrimage / that Allah is free from obligation to the polytheists

ar: لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

en: There is no doubt in it, from the Lord of the worlds
And indeed, it is in the scriptures of the former peoples
And the end of the disbelievers / is the Fire
This is not but legends of the former peoples
This is not but the custom of the former peoples

ar: يَا مُوسَى / إِنِّي أَنَا الَلَّهُ / رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: yā mūsā / innī anā Allāhu / rabbu al-ʿālamīn
en: O Moses / indeed I am Allah / Lord of the worlds
But I am a messenger / from the Lord of the worlds

ar: وَمَا دُعَاءُ الْكَافِرِينَ / إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ
tr: wamā duʿāʾu al-kāfirīna / illā fī ḍalāl
en: And the supplication of the disbelievers is not / but in error

ar: وَمَا كَيْدُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ
tr: wamā kaydu al-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalāl
en: And the plot of the disbelievers is not but in error
And indeed, Allah / is with the good-doers
And indeed, Allah / He is / the best of providers

ar: يَا فِرْعَوْنُ / إِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: yā firʿawnu / innī rasūlun min rabbi al-ʿālamīn
en: O Pharaoh / indeed I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

ar: الَم . تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ / لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ / مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: alif-lām-mīm . tanzīlu al-kitābi / lā rayba fīhi / min rabbi al-ʿālamīn
en: Alif Lam Meem. The revelation of the Book / there is no doubt in it / from the Lord of the worlds

ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ . الَرَّحْمَنِ الَرَّحِيمِ . مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الَدِّينِ
tr: al-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn . ar-raḥmāni ar-raḥīm . māliki yawmi ad-dīn
en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. The Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Sovereign of the Day of Recompense

ar: إِنَّ صَلَاتِي / وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي / لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: inna ṣalātī / wanusukī wamaḥyāya wamamātī / lillāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn
en: Indeed, my prayer / and my rites of sacrifice and my living and my dying / are for Allah, Lord of the worlds

ar: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ / وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: wasalāmun ʿalā al-mursalīn / wal-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn
en: And peace be upon the messengers / and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds

ar: كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ / هَذَا بَيَانٌ لِلنَّاسِ / وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةٌ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
tr: kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu al-mukadhdhibīn / hādhā bayānun lin-nāsi / wahudan wamawʿiẓatun lil-muttaqīn
en: How was the end of the deniers / this is a declaration for the people / and guidance and advice for the righteous

ar: إِنَّ الَلَّهَ / جَامِعُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْكَافِرِينَ / فِي جَهَنَّمَ جَمِيعًا
tr: inna Allāha / jāmiʿu al-munāfiqīna wal-kāfirīna / fī jahannama jamīʿā
en: Indeed, Allah / will gather the hypocrites and disbelievers / in Hell all together

ar: يَا قَوْمِ / لَيْسَ بِي سَفَاهَةٌ / وَلَكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: yā qawmi / laysa bī safāhatun / walākinnī rasūlun min rabbi al-ʿālamīn
en: O my people / there is no foolishness in me / but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

ar: فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ / رَبِّ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ / وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ / وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
tr: falillāhi al-ḥamdu / rabbi as-samāwāti warabbi al-arḍi rabbi al-ʿālamīn / walahu al-kibriyāʾu fī as-samāwāti wal-arḍi / wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīm
en: Then to Allah belongs praise / Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds / and to Him belongs majesty in the heavens and the earth / and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

And You are the best of providers
And You are the best of senders
And You are the best of deciders
And I am the best of senders

ar: أَلَا / لَهُ الْحُكْمُ / وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ الْحَاسِبِينَ
tr: alā / lahu al-ḥukmu / wahuwa asraʿu al-ḥāsibīn
en: Unquestionably / to Him belongs the judgement / and He is the swiftest of reckoners

ar: فَالَلَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا / وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الَرَّاحِمِينَ
tr: fa-Allāhu khayrun ḥāfiẓan / wahuwa arḥamu ar-rāḥimīn
en: But Allah is the best guardian / and He is the most merciful of the merciful

ar: إِنْ كَانَ / لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدٌ / فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَ
tr: in kāna / lir-raḥmāni waladun / fa-anā awwalu al-ʿābidīn
en: If there were / for the Most Merciful a son / then I would be the first of the worshippers

ar: إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي / وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ / وَأَنْتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ
tr: inna ibnī min ahlī / wa-inna waʿdaka al-ḥaqqu / wa-anta aḥkamu al-ḥākimīn
en: Indeed, my son is of my family / and indeed, Your promise is true / and You are the most just of judges
Indeed, the righteous / will be in pleasure
And indeed, the wicked / will be in Hellfire
Indeed, Allah / to the people is Kind and Merciful
Indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire
And what is with Allah / is best for the righteous
And for women is a share
And Allah is Seeing of the servants
Who are my helpers / for Allah
And He is the Subjugator / over His servants
Praise be to Allah, and peace upon His servants

ar: وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ / وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ
tr: wahuwa al-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādihī / wahuwa al-ḥakīmu al-khabīr
en: And He is the Subjugator over His servants / and He is the Wise, the Acquainted

ar: كَلَّا / إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ / لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
tr: kallā / inna kitāba al-abrāri / lafī ʿilliyyīn
en: No! / Indeed, the record of the righteous / is in Illiyyin

ar: كَلَّا / إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ / لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
tr: kallā / inna kitāba al-fujjāri / lafī sijjīn
en: No! / Indeed, the record of the wicked / is in Sijjeen

ar: إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ / الْيَوْمَ / فِي شُغُلٍ / فَاكِهُونَ
tr: inna aṣḥāba al-jannati / al-yawma / fī shughulin / fākihūn
en: Indeed the companions of Paradise / today / are in amusement / happy

ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ / لَذِكْرَى لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
tr: inna fī dhālika / ladhikrā li-ulī al-albāb
en: Indeed, in that / is a reminder for those of understanding

ar: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ / وَاخْتِلَافِ الَلَّيْلِ وَالَنَّهَارِ / لَآيَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
tr: inna fī khalqi as-samāwāti wal-arḍi / wakhtilāfi al-layli wan-nahāri / laʾāyātin li-ulī al-albāb
en: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth / and the alternation of the night and the day / are signs for those of understanding

ar: وَوَيْلٌ لِلْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ / وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ هُمْ مِنَ الْمَقْبُوحِينَ
tr: Wa-waylun lil-kaafireena min 'adhabin shadeed / wa-yawmal-qiyaamati hum minal-maqbuuheen
en: And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment / and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the disgraced
They are in disagreement about it
And they are disbelievers in the Hereafter
And they are deniers of it
And they will abide therein forever
And they are racing toward it (the good deeds)
And they will be in utter despair therein
And they are sincere well-wishers to him
They are the givers of Zakah (performers of charity)
They are those who turn away from vain talk
And they, in their heedlessness, are turning away
And they are bowing down (in prayer)
And they are those who associate partners with Allah
And they are those who are arrogant
And they are those who are averse (disliking)
And they are those who turn away
And they are safe and sound
And they are filled with awe and fear
They are the ones who have gone astray
They are the truthful (the Siddiqeen — highest rank of truthfulness)
They are those whose good deeds are multiplied
They are the rightly guided ones
They are the transgressors (those who exceed bounds)
They are the ones who transgress limits
Indeed the hypocrites — they are the defiantly disobedient
And they — about the Hereafter — they are heedless
And they — in the Hereafter — they are indeed disbelievers
And they — in the remembrance of the Most Merciful — are disbelievers
And they — in the Hereafter — they will be the greatest losers
and their refuge is the Fire
the Hour is their appointed time
Allah is their destroyer or their punisher
and their clothing therein is silk
and most of them are liars
some of them are enemies to others
some of them are allies to others
their omen is only with Allah
their affair is only with Allah
that is their example in the Torah
that is their extent of knowledge
and their greeting therein will be peace
their hearts are in ignorance of this
this is their accommodation on the Day of Judgment
indeed, the Day of Judgment is their appointed time
and his wives are their mothers
and their plot is with Allah
their guidance is not upon you
and most of them are averse to the truth
so those are their houses, empty
and their affair is determined by consultation among themselves
that the water is to be shared between them

ar: ذَلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي الَتَّوْرَاةِ / وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ
tr: dhalika mathaluhum fit-tawrah / wa mathaluhum fil-injil
en: that is their example in the Torah, and their example in the Gospel

ar: ذَلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ / إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ
tr: dhalika mablaghuhum minal-'ilm / inna rabbaka huwa a'lam
en: that is their extent of knowledge; indeed, your Lord is most knowing
the hypocrite men and hypocrite women are of one another
indeed, the Day of Judgment is the appointed time for all of them
their hearts are denying, and they are arrogant
and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination

ar: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ / ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ / وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
tr: mata'un qalil / thumma ma'wahum jahannam / wa bi'sal-mihad
en: a brief enjoyment; then their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place

ar: هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ / عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ
tr: hum wa azwajuhum fi dhilal / 'alal-ara'iki muttaki'un
en: they and their spouses will be in shades, reclining on adorned couches

ar: دَعْوَاهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَكَ الَلَّهُمَّ / وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَامٌ
tr: da'wahum fiha subhanakallahumma / wa tahiyyatuhum fiha salam
en: their call therein will be, 'Exalted are You, O Allah,' and their greeting therein will be, 'Peace'

ar: وَإِنَّ الَظَّالِمِينَ / بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ / وَالَلَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ
tr: wa innadh-dhalimin / ba'dhuhum awliyau ba'dh / wallahu waliyyul-muttaqin
en: and indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous

ar: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ
en: or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower
and with them will be women limiting their glances, of equal age
while they have the Torah, in which is the judgment of Allah

ar: مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ الَلَّهِ / وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ / أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ / رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ
tr: Muhammadun rasulullah / wal-ladhina ma'ahu / ashidda'u 'alal-kuffari / ruhama'u baynahum
en: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves

ar: إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ / الْيَوْمَ / فِي شُغُلٍ فَاكِهُونَ . هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ / عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ
tr: inna ashabal-jannah / al-yawma / fi shughulin fakihun . hum wa azwajuhum fi dhilal / 'alal-ara'iki muttaki'un
en: indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in joyful occupation; they and their spouses in shades, reclining on adorned couches

ar: بَلِ الَسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ / وَالَسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ / إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ
tr: balis-sa'atu maw'iduhum / was-sa'atu adha wa amarr / innal-mujrimina fi dhalalin wa su'ur
en: but the Hour is their appointment, and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter. Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness

ar: دَعْوَاهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَكَ الَلَّهُمَّ / وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَامٌ / وَآخِرُ دَعْوَاهُمْ أَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: da'wahum fiha subhanakallahumma / wa tahiyyatuhum fiha salam / wa akhiru da'wahum anil-hamdu lillahi rabbil-'alamin
en: their call therein will be, 'Exalted are You, O Allah,' and their greeting therein will be, 'Peace.' And the last of their call will be, 'Praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds!'

ar: غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَذِلَّةٌ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الَدُّنْيَا
tr: ghadhabun min rabbihim wa dhillatun fil-hayatid-dunya
en: anger from their Lord and humiliation in the worldly life

tr: wa min aba'ihim wa dhurriyyatihim wa ikhwanihim
en: and from their fathers and their descendants and their brothers

ar: وَبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَرْيَمَ بُهْتَانًا عَظِيمًا
tr: wa bikufrihim wa qawlihim 'ala maryama buhtanan 'adhima
en: and for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander

ar: وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ الَلَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ
tr: wal-mujahiduna fi sabilillahi bi'amwalihim wa anfusihim
en: and those who strive in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives

ar: مِنَ الَظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى الَنُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ
tr: minadh-dhulumati ilan-nuri bi'idhni rabbihim ila siratil-'azizil-hamid
en: from darknesses into the light, by permission of their Lord, to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy
and it is the truth from their Lord
in their hearts is a disease
is there in their hearts a disease?
indeed, their killing is a great sin
that is their saying with their mouths
but they, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers
my Lord is most knowing of their number
and Allah, from behind them, is encompassing
indeed, their appointment is the morning

ar: لَّا خَيْرَ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِّن نَّجْوَاهُمْ
tr: la khayra fi kathirin min najwahum
en: no good is there in much of their private conversation
in their wealth is a known right

ar: لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِي مَسْكَنِهِمْ آيَةٌ
tr: laqad kana lisaba'in fi maskanihim ayah
en: there was for Saba in their dwelling place a sign
and indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory
the hand of Allah is over their hands

ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتِ الَنَّعِيمِ
en: indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure
and from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived

ar: سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ الَسُّجُودِ
en: their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration

ar: إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الَصُّبْحُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ الَصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ
en: indeed, their appointment is the morning. Is not the morning near?
the Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلْمِهِمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
tr: wa inna rabbaka ladhu maghfiratin lin-nasi 'ala zulmihim wa inna rabbaka lashadidul-'iqab
en: and indeed, your Lord is full of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty

ar: وَالَلَّهُ مِن وَرَائِهِم مُّحِيطٌ . بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَّجِيدٌ . فِي لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ
tr: wallahu min wara'ihim muhit . bal huwa qur'anun majid . fi lawhin mahfudh
en: while Allah encompasses them from behind. But this is an honored Qur'an, [inscribed] in a Preserved Slate

ar: سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ الَسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي الَتَّوْرَاةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنجِيلِ
tr: simahum fi wujuhihim min atharis-sujud dhalika mathaluhum fit-tawrati wa mathaluhum fil-injil
en: their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel...

ar: وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الَنَّاسِ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَافِرُونَ
tr: wa inna kathiran minan-nasi biliqa'i rabbihim lakafirun
en: and indeed, many among the people are disbelievers in the meeting with their Lord
they in their prayer are humbly submissive
they who are constant in their prayer
they are fearful of the punishment of their Lord
they, from fear of their Lord, are apprehensive
they are observant of their trusts and their covenants
they are standing firm in their testimonies
they are heedless of their prayer
they are turning away from the remembrance of their Lord
but they are turning away from their reminder
the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord
indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe
those who are constant in their prayer
those who are humbly submissive in their prayer
and those who are standing firm in their testimonies
and those who are observant of their trusts and their covenants
and those who guard their private parts

ar: وَالَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
en: and those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord
those who are heedless of their prayer

ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ . الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
en: so woe to those who pray, those who are heedless of their prayer

ar: وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ . لِّلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ
tr: walladhina fi amwalihim haqqun ma'lum . lissa'ili wal-mahrum
en: and those within whose wealth is a known right for the petitioner and the deprived
for them the gates of heaven
to them on the Day of Resurrection
upon them from the sky a sign
to them the verses of the Most Merciful
for them the heaven and the earth
it is all the same for them
to a man from among them
a group of them with you
among them a messenger from themselves
for them from Allah a great bounty
upon them until the Day of Resurrection
for them provision from the heavens and the earth
upon them a door from the heaven
upon them blessings from the heaven and the earth
to them a book from the heaven
upon them blessings from the heaven
upon them from the heaven an angel
a witness over them from among themselves
among them a messenger from themselves
except Your chosen servants among them
to them their treaty until their term
that for them is a good reward
for them is a great reward
and for them is a noble reward
for them is a known provision
for them are gardens of pleasure
for them is the home of peace
and for them is their provision
for them is a reward uninterrupted
for them are the good things
for them is forgiveness and a great reward
for them is forgiveness and a large reward
for them is forgiveness and a noble provision
for them are degrees with their Lord
for them is their reward and their light
for them therein is enduring pleasure
and for them therein are purified spouses
for them are the gardens of Paradise
and for them therein are of all fruits
for them therein is the home of eternity
so there will be no fear concerning them
upon them are blessings from their Lord and mercy

ar: لَهُمْ دَارُ الَسَّلَامِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمْ
tr: lahum darus-salami 'inda rabbihim wa huwa waliyyuhum
en: for them is the home of peace with their Lord, and He is their protecting friend

ar: لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَىٰ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الَدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ
en: for them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter

ar: لَهُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
tr: lahum darajatun 'inda rabbihim wa maghfiratun wa rizqun karim
en: for them are degrees with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision

ar: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ الَثَّمَرَاتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ
tr: wa lahum fiha min kullith-thamarati wa maghfiratun min rabbihim
en: and for them therein are all fruits and forgiveness from their Lord

ar: وَقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ
tr: wa qulubuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim raji'un
en: and their hearts fearful because they will be returning to their Lord

ar: لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَىٰ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الَدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَاتِ الَلَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
tr: lahumul-bushra fil-hayatid-dunya wa fil-akhirati la tabdila likalimatillahi dhalika huwal-fawzul-'adhim
en: For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words of Allah. That is what is the great attainment

ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ الَلَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ . أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ . فَوَاكِهُ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ . فِي جَنَّاتِ الَنَّعِيمِ
tr: illa 'ibadallahil-mukhlasin . ula'ika lahum rizqun ma'lum . fawakihu wa hum mukramun . fi jannatin-na'im
en: Except the chosen servants of Allah. Those will have a known provision, fruits; and they will be honored, in the gardens of pleasure
for them is the fire of Hell
and for them is the punishment of the Fire
for them is the punishment of burning
for them in the world is disgrace
for them is disgrace in the world
and for them is a painful punishment
and for them is a humiliating punishment
and for them is a great punishment
for them is a severe punishment
and for them is an enduring punishment
and for them is a continuous punishment
for them is a terrible account
for them is the evil of the home
and the Fire is a residence for them
upon them is a fire closed over
for them are garments of fire
and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire
and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment
for them is punishment in the worldly life
a brief enjoyment, and for them is a painful punishment
and for them is the curse, and for them is the evil home
for them is a painful punishment of foul nature
indeed, they are unclean, and their refuge is Hell
and for them are maces of iron
for them therein is heavy sighing and sobbing
for them from Hell is a bed
upon them is the curse of Allah and the angels

ar: فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى
en: in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness

ar: لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ فِي الَدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
en: for them is a painful punishment in the world and the Hereafter

ar: لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
tr: lahum sharabun min hamimin wa 'adhabun alim
en: for them is a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment

ar: لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
tr: laysa lahum ta'amun illa min dhari'
en: there is no food for them except from a bitter, thorny plant

ar: فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ
en: for them is the punishment of Hell, and for them is the punishment of burning

ar: وَعَلَىٰ أَبْصَارِهِمْ غِشَاوَةٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: and over their vision is a veil, and for them is a great punishment

ar: لَهُمْ خِزْيٌ فِي الَدُّنْيَا وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
tr: lahum khizyun fid-dunya wa lahum fil-akhirati 'adhabun 'adhim
en: for them is disgrace in the world, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment

ar: لَهُمْ فِي الَدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
tr: lahum fid-dunya khizyun wa lahum fil-akhirati 'adhabun 'adhim
en: for them in the world is disgrace, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment

ar: فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ الَلَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: so upon them is anger from Allah, and for them is a great punishment

ar: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ الَنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ
tr: lahum min fawqihim dhulalun minan-nari wa min tahtihim dhulal
en: for them from above them are canopies of fire and from below them are canopies

ar: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُّحِيطٌ
tr: ala innahum fi miryatin min liqa'i rabbihim ala innahu bikulli shay'in muhit
en: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing

ar: حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
tr: hujjatuhum dahidhatun 'inda rabbihim wa 'alayhim ghadhabun wa lahum 'adhabun shadid
en: their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is anger and for them is a severe punishment

ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَآكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ . ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ . ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ
tr: fa'innahum la'akiluna minha famali'una minhal-butun . thumma inna lahum 'alayha lashawban min hamim . thumma inna marji'ahum la'ilal-jahim
en: then indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies. Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water. Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire
for indeed, they are enemies to me
then indeed, he is of them
for indeed, they are Your servants
they have no knowledge of it
their Lord is most knowing of them
and they have upon me a [claim of] sin
and many of them are defiantly disobedient
and that they will return to Him

tr: wa lahum fiha manafi'u wa masharib
en: and for them therein are benefits and drinks
indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die
among them is a moderate community
indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted
as if they were alarmed donkeys
and that the disbelievers have no protector
and indeed, I will send to them a gift
or do they have the dominion of the heavens and the earth
and the disbelievers will have a severe punishment

ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
en: for indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds

ar: لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَلِيٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ
tr: laysa lahum min dunihi waliyyun wa la shafi'
en: there is not for them besides Him any protector or intercessor

tr: wa lahum a'malun min duni dhalik
en: but they have deeds besides that
so indeed, it is forbidden to them for forty years

ar: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِمْ مُؤْصَدَةٌ . فِي عَمَدٍ مُمَدَّدَةٍ
en: indeed, it is closed over them. In extended columns

ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ
en: indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them

ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِنْ دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ
tr: bal qulubuhum fi ghamratin min hadha wa lahum a'malun min duni dhalika hum laha 'amilun
en: but their hearts are covered with ignorance of this, and they have deeds besides that which they are doing
you are innocent / free of obligation
are you Muslims? | Are you all Muslims?
so will you desist? | Will you then desist?
so will you avert? | Can you then avail anything?
are you gathered? | Are you all gathering together?
while you are averse to it
while you are heedless of it
and you are the superior ones
rather, you are a transgressing people
then are you of it deniers?

ar: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
tr: la ilaha illa huwa fahal antum muslimun
en: there is no deity except Him, so are you Muslims?
and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy

ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَنَّاسُ أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى الَلَّهِ وَالَلَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ
tr: ya ayyuhan-nasu antumul-fuqara'u ilallahi wallahu huwal-ghaniyyul-hamid
en: O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy
And your God is one God
So your God is one God
And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord
That your God is one God
Your Lord is the possessor of vast mercy
Your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth
This is your god and the god of Moses
And your refuge is the Fire
And in the heaven is your provision
And your food is lawful for them
Your glad tidings today are gardens | Your good tidings today are [of] gardens.
I am only a human like you
Your appointment is the day of the festival
And your effort has been appreciated
Then to Me is your return
Then to Him is your return
Some of you are from others
Then what is your assumption about the Lord of the worlds
Some of you are enemies to others
And you will be superior, and Allah is with you
Your protector is only Allah and His Messenger
Allah is a witness between me and you
And I am with you among the witnesses
Between you and them is a treaty

ar: أَنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
tr: annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimun
en: That your God is one God, so will you be Muslims?
And among His signs is your sleep by night and day

ar: بَلِ الَلَّهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الَنَّاصِرِينَ
en: Nay, Allah is your protector, and He is the best of helpers
Indeed, I am with you among those who wait

ar: إِنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمُ الَلَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: innama ilahukumu-llahu alladhi la ilaha illa hu
en: Your God is only Allah, there is no deity except Him

ar: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الَرَّحْمَٰنُ الَرَّحِيمُ
tr: wa-ilahukum ilahun wahidun la ilaha illa huwa-r-rahmanu-r-rahim
en: And your God is one God, there is no deity except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

ar: مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ إِنَّ الَلَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ
tr: ma khalqukum wa-la ba'thukum illa kanafsin wahidatin inna-llaha sami'un basir
en: Your creation and your resurrection are not but as a single soul, indeed Allah is Hearing and Seeing

ar: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ
tr: wa-inna hadhihi ummatukum ummatan wahidatan wa-ana rabbukum
en: And indeed, this is your religion, one religion, and I am your Lord

ar: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُقْتَحِمٌ مَعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا الَنَّارِ
tr: hadha fawjun muqtahimun ma'akum la marhaban bihim innahum salu-nnar
en: This is a group plunging in with you, no welcome for them, indeed they will burn in the Fire

ar: أَنَّمَا الْحَيَاةُ الَدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ
tr: annama-l-hayatu-d-dunya la'ibun wa-lahwun wa-zinatun wa-tafakhurun baynakum wa-takathurun fi-l-amwali wa-l-awlad
en: That the worldly life is only amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children

ar: إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَالَلَّهُ عِنْدَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
tr: innama amwalukum wa-awladukum fitnah wa-llahu 'indahu ajrun 'azhim
en: Your wealth and your children are only a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward

ar: أُمَّهَاتُكُمْ وَبَنَاتُكُمْ وَأَخَوَاتُكُمْ وَعَمَّاتُكُمْ وَخَالَاتُكُمْ وَبَنَاتُ الْأَخِ وَبَنَاتُ الْأُخْتِ
tr: ummahatukum wa-banatukum wa-akhawatukum wa-'ammatukum wa-khalatukum wa-banatu-l-akhi wa-banatu-l-ukht
en: your mothers, your daughters, your sisters, your paternal aunts, your maternal aunts, your brother's daughters, and your sister's daughters
In the way of Allah with your wealth and yourselves
Indeed the most noble of you
And indeed your Lord is the Most Merciful
And Allah knows best about your faith
Indeed your Lord is Most Compassionate, Most Merciful
And Allah knows best about your enemies
Your Lord knows best what is in your souls | Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves
In it is tranquility from your Lord
Then to your Lord is your return
Then indeed your destination is to the Fire
And indeed most of you are defiantly disobedient
Your rebellion is only against yourselves
The truth is from your Lord

ar: إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ الَلّٰهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ / إِنَّ الَلّٰهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
tr: inna akramakum indallahi atqakum / innallaha aleemun khabeerun
en: Indeed the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you / Indeed Allah is Knowing and Acquainted
And indeed your Lord is the Most Merciful
Indeed your God is surely One
And Allah knows best about your faith
Indeed your Lord is most Kind, most Merciful
Indeed your efforts are surely diverse
And Allah knows best your enemies
Your Lord knows best what is in your souls
In it is tranquility from your Lord
Then to your Lord is your return
For indeed your destination is the Fire
And that most of you are defiantly disobedient
Your transgression is only against your own selves
The truth is from your Lord

ar: إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ الَلهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ إِنَّ الَلهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
tr: inna akramakum 'indallahi atqakum inna allaha 'aleemun khabirun
en: Indeed the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. Indeed Allah is Knowing, Acquainted.
upon you the manna and quails
upon you / the verses of Allah
the favor of Allah / upon you
and for you in the earth
and for you are your deeds
the night and the day for you
for you on the Day of Resurrection
the night as a garment for you
then indeed you on the Day of Resurrection
the mercy of Allah and His blessings upon you
water from the sky upon you
the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy
from the Book and wisdom upon you
anger from your Lord upon you
to you a messenger / a witness over you
among you / a messenger from yourselves
for you the sun and the moon
for you your Lord / from His mercy
for you an example from yourselves
from the sky water for you
the legal retribution upon you / concerning the murdered
from you angels on the earth
to you / from Allah and His messenger
to you a book / in which is your mention
the Messenger a witness over you
the Messenger over you a witness
upon you a punishment from above you
for the people against you an argument
for you hearing and vision and hearts
for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon

ar: فَضْلُ الَلّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ / وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي الَدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
en: the favor of Allah upon you / and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter

ar: عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعَكُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارَكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ
tr: alaykum sam'akum wala absaarakum wala juloodukum
en: against you your hearing nor your vision nor your skins

ar: يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
tr: ya qawmi innee lakum nadheerun mubeenun
en: O my people, indeed I am a clear warner to you
indeed I am for you a trustworthy messenger
that I am the messenger of Allah to you
and I am to you a trustworthy advisor
I am to you a clear warner
indeed I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings
I am only a clear warner to you
then indeed Allah is free of need of you
what remains from Allah is better for you
and it is better for you
and it is worse for you
while it is disliked by you
it is an army for you
that is better for you and purer
so it is better for you
indeed I am sending it down to you
indeed Satan is to you an enemy
indeed he is to you a clear enemy
indeed I am free of you
for you in it is good
so there is no blame upon you
then indeed you after that are to die
then indeed you will be victorious
that you are allies of Allah
indeed you are in a new creation
indeed you / you are the wrongdoers
indeed you / are in differing speech
indeed you will be resurrected after death
indeed you will taste the painful punishment
and for you is a great punishment
yes, and indeed you are of the ones brought near
for you is the dominion today
then for you is a great reward
for you in them is warmth and benefits
for you in it is much fruit
and for you in legal retribution is life
and for you in them are many benefits
there was for you a victory from Allah
or are there for Him daughters / and for you sons
is it for you the male / and for Him the female
indeed this was a reward for you
or do you have a clear authority
so among you is a disbeliever and among you is a believer
and for you in them is beauty
for you in them is a good example
that among you is the Messenger of Allah

ar: إِنَّ مَا عِنْدَ الَلّٰهِ / هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ
tr: inna ma indallahi / huwa khayrun lakum
en: indeed what is with Allah / that is better for you
there was for you in them a good example
for me are my deeds and for you are your deeds
for you is your religion, and for me is my religion
so no one can overcome you
then upon you is the victory
and indeed I am a neighbor to you
then for you is a fourth
you have no knowledge of it
and indeed for you / in the grazing livestock / is a lesson
and among you is His Messenger
your Lord is most knowing of you

ar: وَيَا قَوْمِ / هٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ الَلّٰهِ لَكُمْ
en: and O my people / this is the she-camel of Allah for you

ar: يَابَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ الَلّٰهِ إِلَيْكُمْ
tr: ya banee isra'eela innee rasoolullahi ilaykum
en: O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allah to you

ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَنَّاسُ إِنِّي رَسُولُ الَلّٰهِ إِلَيْكُمْ
en: O mankind, indeed I am the messenger of Allah to you

ar: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ الَلّٰهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ
tr: laqad kaana lakum fee rasoolillahi uswatun hasanatun
en: there has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah a good example

ar: كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ
tr: kaanat lakum uswatun hasanatun fee ibraheema
en: there has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham

ar: إِنَّ / مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ / عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ
tr: inna / min azwaajikum wa awlaadikum / aduwwan lakum
en: indeed / among your spouses and your children / is an enemy to you

ar: إِنَّ هٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَاءً / وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُمْ مَّشْكُورًا
tr: inna hadha kaana lakum jazaa'an / wakaana sa'yukum mashkooran
en: indeed this is for you a reward / and your effort has been appreciated
and for you are your deeds / peace be upon you

ar: وَلَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ / وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
tr: walakum fil-ardhi mustaqarrun / wamataa'un ila heenin
en: and for you on the earth is a place of settlement / and enjoyment for a time

ar: وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقِصَاصِ حَيَاةٌ / يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
en: and for you in legal retribution is life / O you of understanding
there is no blame upon you nor upon them

ar: لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ الْيَوْمَ مِنَ الَنَّاسِ
en: no one can overcome you today from among the people
Yes, and indeed, you will be among those made near
We are the helpers of Allah.
We are the children of Allah and His beloved ones.
And we are closer to him than you.

ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيْدِ
tr: wa nahnu aqrabu ilayhi min hablil wareed
en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
Indeed, Allah is poor and we are wealthy.

ar: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ الَلّٰهِ صِبْغَةً وَنَحْنُ لَهُ عَابِدُوْنَ
tr: wa man ahsanu minallaahi sibghatan wa nahnu lahu 'aabidoon
en: And whose religion is better than Allah's? And we are His worshippers.
We are the ones who glorify.
We are the ones who send down.
Sufficient for us | sufficient for us
Our signs upon them | Upon them our verses
The Children of Israel with us
An appointment between us and you | Between us and you an appointment
Allah is our Lord and your Lord
And our Lord is the Most Merciful
And He is our Lord and your Lord
You are our Protector | You are our protector
He is our Master/Protector | He is our master
Exalted are You / You are our Protector | Exalted are You / You are our protector
And our father is an old man
You are our Protector instead of them
Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth
Are our gods better, or is he?
Indeed, our testimony is truer than their testimony | Our testimony is more true than their testimony
And with us is a record | And with us is a book
And with us is a preserving record

tr: fa idhaa hum jamee'un ladaynaa muhdaroona
en: Then they all will be brought before Us

ar: وَإِلٰهُنَا وَإِلٰهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ / وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُوْنَ
tr: wa ilaahunaa wa ilaahukum waahidun / wa nahnu lahu muslimoona
en: And our God and your God is One / and we are Muslims to Him
With us the children of Israel
Allah is our Lord and your Lord
And our Lord is the Most Merciful
And our father is an old man
You are our protector besides them
Are our gods better / or is he
And with us is a guarding book
Then indeed they will all be brought before Us

ar: وَإِلَهُنَا وَإِلَهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ / وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ
tr: wa-ilahuna wa-ilahukum wahidun / wa-nahnu lahu muslimoona
en: And our God and your God is One / and we are Muslims to Him
Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative
Indeed, our father is in clear error
Indeed, it is the truth from our Lord
And this is for our partners
Glory be to our Lord | Exalted is our Lord.
Indeed, he was stubborn towards Our verses
Indeed, he is of Our believing servants
Indeed, he is of Our chosen servants
And indeed, Our soldiers will be the victors
And that our return is to Allah
Then upon Our Messenger is only the clear conveyance
And those who are heedless of Our signs
Indeed, they both were of Our believing servants

ar: وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الَنَّاسِ عَنْ آيَاتِنَا لَغَافِلُونَ
en: And indeed, many among the people are heedless of Our signs

ar: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ. وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
en: Indeed, he is of Our believing servants. And indeed, Lot was of the messengers

ar: وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَا إِلَى الَلَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الَنَّارِ
tr: Wa-anna maraddana ilal-lahi wa-annal-musrifeena hum ashabun-nar
en: And that our return is to Allah and that the transgressors will be the companions of the Fire

ar: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا. وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
tr: Inna ladayna ankalan wa-jaheema. Wa-ta'aman tha ghussatin wa-'athaban aleema
en: Indeed, with Us are shackles and burning fire. And food that chokes and a painful punishment

ar: مَا فِي بُطُونِ هَٰذِهِ الْأَنْعَامِ خَالِصَةٌ لِّذُكُورِنَا وَمُحَرَّمٌ عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِنَا
tr: Ma fee butooni hathihil-an'ami khalisatun lithukoorina wa-muharramun 'ala azwajina
en: What is in the bellies of these cattle is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our wives
thus it is a right upon us
and upon us is the reckoning
upon us stones from the sky
upon us a table spread from the sky
and indeed we, to our Lord

ar: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا إِيَابَهُمْ ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُمْ
tr: Inna ilayna iyabahum, thumma inna AAalayna hisabahum
en: Indeed, to Us is their return. Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
And among us are Muslims, and among us are the unjust.

ar: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِّنَ الَسَّمَاءِ
tr: Inna munziloona AAala ahli hathihi alqaryati rijzan mina assama-i
en: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky.

ar: وَهُوَ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ وَلَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُخْلِصُونَ
tr: Wahuwa rabbuna warabbukum walana aAAmaluna walakum aAAmalukum wanahnu lahu mukhlisoon
en: And He is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. And we are sincere to Him.

ar: الَلَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ
tr: Allahu rabbuna warabbukum lana aAAmaluna walakum aAAmalukum la hujjata baynana wabaynakum
en: Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. There is no argument between us and you.

ar: لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
tr: Layoosufu waakhoohu ahabbu ila abeena minna wanahnu AAusbah, inna abana lafee dalalin mubeen
en: Indeed, Yusuf and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error.
And indeed, we will be its guardian.
And indeed, We are its expander.
Indeed, it is we who will be the victors.
And indeed, it is we who exalt [Him].
And indeed, to our Lord we will return.
Indeed, we are lost. Rather, we have been deprived.

ar: إِنَّا إِلَيْكُم لَّمُرْسَلُونَ. وَمَا عَلَيْنَا إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ
tr: Inna ilaykum lamursaloon. Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeen
en: Indeed, to you we are sent as messengers. And there is not upon us except clear notification.

ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ. وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْآخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَىٰ
tr: Inna AAalayna lalhuda. Wa-inna lana lalaakhirata wal-oola
en: Indeed, upon Us is [to give] guidance. And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
Those are the companions of Paradise
Those are the companions of the Fire
And those are the companions of the Fire
Those are the companions of Hellfire
And those are among the righteous
Then those are with the believers
Those are upon guidance from their Lord
Those are among the most humiliated
Those will be honored in gardens
Those are the companions of the right
Those are the party of Allah
Those are the party of Satan
Then those will be brought into the punishment

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
en: Those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الَنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
en: Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ حِزْبُ الَلَّهِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الَلَّهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
tr: ulā'ika ḥizbu 'llāhi alā inna ḥizba 'llāhi humu 'l-mufliḥūn
en: Those are the party of Allah. Unquestionably, the party of Allah - they are the successful

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ حِزْبُ الَشَّيْطَانِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الَشَّيْطَانِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
tr: ulā'ika ḥizbu 'sh-shayṭāni alā inna ḥizba 'sh-shayṭāni humu 'l-khāsirūn
en: Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they are the losers
Those will have a painful punishment
Those will have a humiliating punishment
And those will have a painful punishment
And those will have a great punishment
So those, for them is a humiliating punishment
Those, for them is a terrible reckoning
And those, for them are the good things
Those, for them is the curse
Those, upon them is the curse of Allah
Those, for them is forgiveness and a great reward
Those, for them is forgiveness and a noble provision
Those, for them are gardens of perpetual residence
Those, for them is a known provision
So those, their refuge is Hell
Those, their refuge is the Fire
Those are the ones for whom is a terrible punishment

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الَلَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الَدَّارِ
en: Those, for them is the curse, and for them is the terrible home
So those, for them are the highest ranks

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ لَا خَلَاقَ لَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ
en: Those, no share for them in the Hereafter

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
en: Those, for them is a punishment of a painful torment
Those, for them is security and they are rightly guided
And those, the shackles will be in their necks
Those, some of them are allies of others

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ
en: Those, upon them are blessings from their Lord and mercy

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا الَنَّارُ
en: Those are the ones for whom there is nothing in the Hereafter except the Fire

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ جَزَاؤُهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنَّاتٌ
tr: Ula'ika jaza'uhum maghfiratun min rabbihim wa-jannat
en: Those, their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ الَلَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
tr: Ula'ika lahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim innallaha sari'ul-hisab
en: Those, for them is their reward with their Lord, indeed Allah is swift in account

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةُ الَلَّهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالَنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: Those, upon them is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْحِسَابِ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
tr: Ula'ika lahum su'ul-hisabi wa-ma'wahum jahannamu wa-bi'sal-mihad
en: Those, for them is a terrible reckoning, and their refuge is Hell, and what a wretched resting place

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ
tr: Ula'ikal-ladhina lahum su'ul-'adhabi wa-hum fil-akhirati humul-akhsarun
en: Those are the ones for whom is a terrible punishment, and they in the Hereafter are the greatest losers

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةَ الَلَّهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالَنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
tr: Ula'ika jaza'uhum anna 'alayhim la'natallahi wal-mala'ikati wan-nasi ajma'in
en: Those, their reward is that upon them is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people
Those are the ones who are the best of creation
Those are the ones who are the worst of creation
And those are the ones who are the fuel of the Fire
And those are the ones who are the people of understanding

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ جَزَاؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ
tr: Ula'ika hum khayrul-bariyyati jaza'uhum 'inda rabbihim jannatu 'adnin
en: Those are the ones who are the best of creation, their reward with their Lord is gardens of perpetual residence
Those are the steadfast affirmers of truth
And those are the rightly guided
Then those are the ones who multiply (their reward)
Then those are the liars in the sight of Allah

ar: وَأُولٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الْخَيْرَاتُ / وَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
tr: Wa ula'ika lahumul khayrat / wa ula'ika humul muflihun
en: And those will have the good things / and those are the successful

ar: أُولٰئِكَ عَلٰى هُدًى مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ / وَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
tr: Ula'ika 'ala hudam mir rabbihim / wa ula'ika humul muflihun
en: Those are upon guidance from their Lord / and those are the successful

ar: أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ حَقًّا / لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيْمٌ
tr: Ula'ika humul mu'minuna haqqa / lahum maghfiratuw wa rizqun karim
en: Those are the true believers / for them is forgiveness and noble provision

ar: أُولٰئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ / وَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُوْنَ
tr: Ula'ika 'alayhim shalawatum mir rabbihim wa rahmah / wa ula'ika humul muhtadun
en: Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy / and those are the rightly guided

ar: أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الَصِّدِّيقُوْنَ وَالَشُّهَدَاءُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ / لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُوْرُهُمْ
tr: Ula'ika humus shiddiquna was syuhada'u 'inda rabbihim / lahum ajruhum wa nuruhum
en: Those are the steadfast affirmers of truth and the martyrs with their Lord / for them is their reward and their light

ar: أُولٰئِكَ كَالْأَنْعَامِ / بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ / أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُوْنَ
tr: Ula'ika kal an'ami / bal hum adhallu / ula'ika humul ghafilun
en: Those are like cattle / rather, they are more astray / those are the heedless

ar: أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ حَقًّا / لَهُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيْمٌ
tr: Ula'ika humul mu'minuna haqqa / lahum darajatun 'inda rabbihim wa maghfiratuw wa rizqun karim
en: Those are the true believers / for them are degrees (of reward) with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision
Indeed, these are a small group
Our Lord, these are our partners
These are our intercessors with Allah
That these are a criminal people
Indeed, these are a small band

ar: لَا إِلَىٰ هٰؤُلَاءِ وَلَا إِلَىٰ هٰؤُلَاءِ
tr: La ila ha'ula'i wa la ila ha'ula'i
en: Neither to these nor to those
O my people! These are my daughters
Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

ar: إِنَّ الَلهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
en: Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
Indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds.
Indeed, Allah is ever Merciful to you.
Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.
Indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.
Indeed, Allah is swift in account.
Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
Indeed, Allah is Seeing of what you do.
Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate.
Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.
Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing.
Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty.
Indeed, your Lord is most knowing.
Indeed, this is the clear trial.
Indeed, this is the great attainment.
Indeed, the plot of Satan has ever been weak.
Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth.
Indeed, the punishment of her Lord is ever to be feared.
Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
Indeed, many among the people are defiantly disobedient.
Indeed, those who deny Our signs.
Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah'.
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds.
Indeed, those who devour the wealth of orphans.
Indeed, mankind is very unjust and ungrateful.
Indeed, mankind is ungrateful to his Lord.
This is nothing but a lie.
He is nothing but a man.
He is nothing but a warner.
It is nothing but a reminder.
This is nothing but clear magic.
He is nothing but a clear warner.
I am nothing but a clear warner.

tr: In ana illa nadziruw wa basyir
en: I am nothing but a warner and a bringer of good tidings.
It is nothing but a reminder for the worlds.
It is nothing but Your trial.
Upon you is nothing but to convey.
The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
They are nothing but like cattle.

ar: إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيْرٍ
tr: In antum illa fi dhalalin kabir
en: You are not but in great error.
You are nothing but human beings.

ar: إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
en: My reward is not but upon the Lord of the worlds.
He is nothing but a slave.
It is nothing but a revelation.
This is nothing but the word of a human being.
This is nothing but a noble angel.
You are nothing but a warner.

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْآنٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
tr: In huwa illa dzikruw wa qur'anum mubin
en: It is nothing but a reminder and a clear Quran.
The decision is only for Allah.
Their account is only upon my Lord.
There is nothing in their breasts but pride.

ar: إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
tr: In antum illa fi dhalalim mubin
en: You are not but in clear error.
We are nothing but human beings like you.

ar: إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ الَلهِ / وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
tr: In ajriya illa 'alallah / wa huwa 'ala kulli syai'in syahid
en: My reward is only upon Allah, and He is witness over all things.

ar: وَهُوَ الَلهُ / لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: Wa huwallah / la ilaha illa huw
en: And He is Allah; there is no deity but Him.

ar: هُوَ رَبِّي / لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: Huwa rabbi / la ilaha illa huw
en: He is my Lord; there is no deity but Him.

ar: حَسْبِيَ الَلهُ / لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
en: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity but Him.

ar: الَلهُ / لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ / الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ
tr: Allahu / la ilaha illa huw / alhayyul qayyum
en: Allah - there is no deity but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.

ar: رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ / لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: Rabbul masyriqi wal maghrib / la ilaha illa huw
en: The Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity but Him.

ar: الَلهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ / رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ
tr: Allahu la ilaha illa huw / rabbul 'arsyil 'azhim
en: Allah - there is no deity but Him, Lord of the Great Throne.

ar: الَلهُ / لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ / لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ
tr: Allahu / la ilaha illa huw / lahul asma'ul husna
en: Allah - there is no deity but Him. To Him belong the best names.
And you are not a believer.
And it is not the word of a poet.
And you will not cause failure.
And we will not be resurrected.
And we will not be punished.
And we will not believe you.
And it is not the word of an expelled Satan.

ar: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ . وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ
tr: innahu laqawlun faslun . wama huwa bilhazli
en: Indeed, it is a decisive statement. And it is not amusement.
Indeed, it is truth, and you will not escape.

ar: وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي الَسَّمَاءِ
tr: wama antum bimu'jizeena fil-ardi wala fissama'i
en: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth or in the heaven.

ar: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الَدُّنْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
tr: in hiya illa hayatunaddunya wama nahnu bimab'ootheena
en: It is not but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected.

ar: وَمَا هُمْ بِخَارِجِينَ مِنْهَا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ
tr: wama hum bikharijeena minha walahum 'adhabun muqeemun
en: And they will not emerge from it, and for them is an enduring punishment.

ar: وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكَارَى وَلَكِنَّ عَذَابَ الَلَّهِ شَدِيدٌ
en: And they are not intoxicated, but the punishment of Allah is severe.
Is there a deity with Allah?
So will you be grateful? | so are you grateful? | Then are you grateful?
So will you be Muslims [submitting to Him]? | so are you Muslims?

ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
tr: la ilaha illa huwa fahal antum muslimoona
en: There is no deity but Him, so will you be Muslims?
Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

ar: هَلْ فِي ذَلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِذِي حِجْرٍ
tr: hal fee dhalika qasamun lidhee hijrin
en: Is there in that an oath for a person of understanding?

ar: إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
tr: ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimoona
en: Your God is one God, so will you be Muslims?

ar: فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِنَ الَنَّارِ
en: So will you avert from us a portion of the Fire?

ar: أَ فِي الَلَّهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
en: Is there doubt about Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth?
Or are you of those who play?
Or do you have a scripture?
Or are We the ones who send down?
Or do you have clear authority?
Or do they have a share in the heavens? | or do they have a partnership in the heavens
Or has He daughters while you have sons?
Or do they have a share of dominion?
Or are with them the depositories of the mercy of your Lord?
Or are they a transgressing people?

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ الَلَّهِ سُبْحَانَ الَلَّهِ
en: Or do they have a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah.
Or are there locks upon [their] hearts?

ar: أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ هَذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ
tr: am ana khayrun min hadhalladhi huwa maheenun
en: Or am I better than this one who is insignificant?

ar: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُسَيْطِرُونَ
en: Or do they possess the depositories of your Lord, or are they the controllers?

ar: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ. أَمْ لَهُمْ مُلْكُ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا
tr: am 'indahum khaza'inu rahmati rabbikal-'azeezil-wahhabi. am lahum mulkussamawati wal-ardi wama baynahuma
en: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower? Or do they have the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them?
Are you more knowing or is Allah?
Are our gods better or is he?

ar: أَ هُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ
tr: a hum khayrun am qawmu tubba'in
en: Are they better or the people of Tubba?

ar: أَ ذَلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الَزَّقُّومِ
tr: a dhalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratuz-zaqqoomi
en: Is that a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?

ar: أَ ذَلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ
en: Is that better or the Garden of Eternity?

ar: أَ أَرْبَابٌ مُتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيْرٌ أَمِ الَلَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
en: Are separate lords better or Allah, the One, the Prevailing?
How can there be for them a reminder?
How can there be for him a reminder?
O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?
But it is worse for them.
But it is good for you.
Rather, to Allah belongs the command entirely.
Rather, for them is an appointed time.
Rather, he is an insolent liar.
Rather, it is the truth from your Lord.
Rather, He is Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Rather, you are a transgressing people. | rather, you are a transgressing people
Rather, it is those who are the wrongdoers.

ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ ذِكْرِي
tr: bal hum fee shakkin min dhikree
en: Rather, they are in doubt about My reminder.
Rather, you - no welcome to you.
Rather, we are a people bewitched.

ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا
tr: bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min hadha
en: Rather, their hearts are in ignorance of this. | but their hearts are in ignorance of this
Rather, they are disbelievers in the meeting with their Lord.

ar: بَلْ هُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِمْ مُعْرِضُونَ
en: Rather, they are turning away from the remembrance of their Lord.
Rather, they are in doubt about it.

ar: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَجِيدٌ . فِي لَوْحٍ مَحْفُوظٍ
tr: bal huwa qur'anun majeedun . fee lawhin mahfoozin
en: But this is an honored Quran, [inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
Those are like cattle; rather, they are more astray.

ar: بَلْ لَهُ مَا فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
en: Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth.
As if it were a canopy.
As if you were familiar with it.
As if it were a snake.
As if it were the heads of devils.
As if he were a devoted friend.
As if they were hidden pearls.
As if they were trunks of palm trees.
As if they were a structure joined firmly.
As if they were alarmed donkeys.
As if they were swarming locusts.
As if they were pieces of wood propped up.
As if it were a pearly [white] star.
Unquestionably, the help of Allah is near.
Unquestionably, the promise of Allah is truth.
Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion.

ar: أَلَا إِنَّ الَلَّهَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الَرَّحِيمُ
en: Unquestionably, indeed Allah is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

ar: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
tr: ala inna lillahi ma fissamawati wal-ardi
en: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth.

ar: أَلَا إِنَّ الَظَّالِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٍ مُقِيمٍ
en: Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in enduring punishment.

ar: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ الَلَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ...
en: Unquestionably, the allies of Allah - there will be no fear concerning them...

ar: أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الَشَّيْطَانِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
en: Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers.
