ar: أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الَلَّهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
en: Unquestionably, the party of Allah - they are the successful.
Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
Is not Allah most knowing of those who are grateful?
Is not Allah the most just of judges?
Is there not among you a reasonable man?
Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?

ar: إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الَصُّبْحُ أَلَيْسَ الَصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ
en: Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near?

ar: لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنَّ الَلَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
en: No injustice today! Indeed, Allah is swift in account.
O my people, to you belongs the dominion today.

ar: إِنَّ الْخِزْيَ الْيَوْمَ وَالَسُّوءَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
en: Indeed, disgrace today and evil are upon the disbelievers.
So your vision today is piercing.

ar: لَكِنِ الَظَّالِمُونَ الْيَوْمَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
en: But the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
No blame will there be upon you today.

ar: لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ مِنَ الَنَّاسِ
en: No one can overcome you today from among the people.

ar: لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ الَلَّهِ
en: There is no protector today from the decree of Allah.

ar: يَا عِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ
en: O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you today.
But they, today, are in submission.

ar: فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: And he is their ally today, and for them is a painful punishment. | so he is their ally today, and for them is a painful punishment

ar: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَاهُنَا حَمِيمٌ . وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
tr: falaysa lahul-yawma hahuna hameemun . wala ta'amun illa min ghisleenin
en: So there is not for him here today any devoted friend. Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds.
And the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
Sovereignty, that Day, is for Allah.
And the weighing [of deeds] that Day will be the truth.
True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful.
To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] driving.
To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
Then indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
Then no relationship will there be among them that Day.
Some faces, that Day, will be radiant.
Some faces, that Day, will be bright.
Some faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
And some faces, that Day, will be contorted.
Some faces, that Day, will be humbled.
And some faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
Hearts, that Day, will tremble, their eyes humbled.

ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاعِمَةٌ لِسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
tr: wujoohun yawma'idhin na'imatun lisa'yiha radiyatun fee jannatin 'aliyah
en: Some faces, that Day, will show pleasure. With their effort [they are] satisfied. In an elevated garden.
There is no deity except Him. Exalted is He.
Allah is but one God. Exalted is He.
There is no deity except You; exalted are You.
Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
Exalted are You. This is a great slander.
Exalted are You. You are our ally, not them.
Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might.
And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds. | And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds
So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne.

ar: وَسُبْحَانَ الَلَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: And exalted is Allah, and I am not of those who associate others with Him.

ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ
en: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne.

ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
en: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things.

ar: سُبْحَانَهُ بَلْ لَهُ مَا فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
tr: subhanahu bal lahu ma fissamawati wal-ardi
en: Exalted is He! Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth.

ar: سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ لَهُ مَا فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
tr: subhanahu huwal-ghaniyyu lahu ma fissamawati wama fil-ardi
en: Exalted is He! He is the Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth.
The heaven and the earth and what is between them.
The heavens and the earth and what is between them.
The East and the West and what is between them.
Lord of the East and the West and what is between them.

ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
tr: walillahi mulkussamawati wal-ardi wama baynahuma wa-ilayhil-maseeru
en: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and to Him is the [final] destination. | And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and to Him is the final destination

ar: لَهُ مَا فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ الَثَّرَى
tr: lahu ma fissamawati wama fil-ardi wama baynahuma wama tahtath-thara
en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ مُلْكُ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا
tr: am lahum mulkussamawati wal-ardi wama baynahuma
en: Or do they have the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them?

ar: إِنَّ إِلَهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ . رَبُّ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ
tr: inna ilahakum lawahidun . rabbussamawati wal-ardi wama baynahuma warabbul-mashariqi
en: Indeed, your God is One, Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.

ar: إِنَّهُ هُوَ الَسَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ . رَبِّ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا
tr: innahu huwas-samee'ul-'aleemu . rabbussamawati wal-ardi wama baynahuma
en: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing, Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them.

ar: إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنْذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِلَّا الَلَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ / رَبُّ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
tr: innama ana mundhirun wama min ilahin illallahul-wahidul-qahharu / rabbussamawati wal-ardi wama baynahumal-'azeezul-ghaffaru
en: I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing. Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
the ones who are able / the powerful ones
Say: To Allah belongs the East and the West.

ar: قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى الَلَّهِ هُوَ الْهُدَىٰ
tr: Qul inna hudā Allāhi huwa al-hudā
en: Say: Indeed the guidance of Allah — it is the true guidance.
Say: Indeed the guidance is the guidance of Allah.
And say: All praise is for Allah.
Then say: The unseen belongs only to Allah.
Say: Indeed all authority belongs to Allah.
Say: The spoils of war belong to Allah and the Messenger.
Say: He is only one God.
Say: Glory be to my Lord.
Say: The signs are only with Allah.
Say: Its knowledge is only with my Lord.
Say: Its knowledge is only with Allah.
Say: Then to Allah belongs the conclusive argument.
Then say: I am indeed free (of it).

ar: قُلْ إِنِّي عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي
en: Say: I am indeed upon a clear proof from my Lord.

tr: Wa qul innī ana al-nadhīru al-mubīnu
en: And say: I am indeed the clear warner.
Say: I am only a human being like you.
Say: I am only a warner.
Say: He is the Most Merciful.
Say: He is Allah, the One.
Then say: Peace be upon you.

ar: قُلْ هُوَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: Qul huwa rabbī lā ilāha illā huwa
en: Say: He is my Lord; there is no god except Him.
Say: It is a great news.
Then say: Your Lord is the Possessor of vast mercy.

ar: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ
tr: Qul adhālika khayrun am jannatu al-khuldi
en: Say: Is that better or the garden of eternity?
And say: The truth is from your Lord.
Say: Reconciliation for them is better.

ar: قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ
en: Say: All praise is for Allah and peace upon His servants.

ar: قُلْ مَتَاعُ الَدُّنْيَا قَلِيلٌ وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ
tr: Qul matā'u al-dunyā qalīlun wal-ākhiratu khayrun
en: Say: The enjoyment of this world is little and the Hereafter is better.
Then say: For me is my deed and for you is your deed.

ar: فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ الَلَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: Faqul ḥasbiya Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa
en: Then say: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god except Him.

tr: Qul liman al-arḍu wa man fīhā
en: Say: To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it?

ar: قُلْ مَن بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
tr: Qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shay'in
en: Say: Who is it in Whose hand is the dominion of all things?

tr: Quli Allāhu shahīdun baynī wa baynakum
en: Say: Allah is a witness between me and you.

ar: قُل لِّلَّهِ الَشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا لَّهُ مُلْكُ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
tr: Qul lillāhi al-shafā'atu jamī'an lahu mulku al-samāwāti wal-arḍi
en: Say: To Allah belongs all intercession; to Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth.

ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ الَسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
tr: Qul man rabbu al-samāwāti al-sab'i wa rabbu al-'arshi al-'aẓīmi
en: Say: Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the great Throne?

ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قُلِ الَلَّهُ
tr: Qul man rabbu al-samāwāti wal-arḍi quli Allāhu
en: Say: Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth? Say: Allah.

ar: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قُل لِّلَّهِ
tr: Qul liman mā fī al-samāwāti wal-arḍi qul lillāhi
en: Say: To whom belongs what is in the heavens and the earth? Say: To Allah.

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِندَ الَلَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
tr: Qul innamā al-'ilmu 'inda Allāhi wa innamā ana nadhīrun mubīnun
en: Say: Knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner.

ar: فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُنذِرِينَ وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
tr: Faqul innamā ana mina al-mundhirīna wa quli al-ḥamdu lillāhi
en: Then say: I am only among the warners, and say: All praise is for Allah.

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْآيَاتُ عِندَ الَلَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
tr: Qul innamā al-āyātu 'inda Allāhi wa innamā ana nadhīrun mubīnun
en: Say: The signs are only with Allah and I am only a clear warner.

ar: قُلِ الَلَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
tr: Quli Allāhu khāliqu kulli shay'in wa huwa al-wāḥidu al-qahhāru
en: Say: Allah is the creator of all things and He is the One, the Irresistible.

ar: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الَنَّاسُ إِنَّمَا أَنَا لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
tr: Qul yā ayyuha al-nāsu innamā ana lakum nadhīrun mubīnun
en: Say: O people! I am only a clear warner to you.

ar: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَأٌ عَظِيمٌ أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
en: Say: It is a great news from which you are turning away.

ar: قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِنَّ الَلَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tr: Qul huwa min 'indi anfusikum inna Allāha 'alā kulli shay'in qadīrun
en: Say: It is from your own selves. Indeed Allah is over all things All-Powerful.

ar: قُلْ مَا عِندَ الَلَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِّنَ الَلَّهْوِ وَمِنَ الَتِّجَارَةِ وَالَلَّهُ خَيْرُ الَرَّازِقِينَ
tr: Qul mā 'inda Allāhi khayrun mina al-lahwi wa mina al-tijārati wallāhu khayru al-rāziqīna
en: Say: What is with Allah is better than amusement and trade; and Allah is the best of providers.

ar: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الَنَّاسُ إِنِّي رَسُولُ الَلَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعًا الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: Qul yā ayyuha al-nāsu innī rasūlu Allāhi ilaykum jamī'an alladhī lahu mulku al-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa
en: Say: O mankind! I am the Messenger of Allah to you all — He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; there is no god but He.

ar: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
tr: Qul inna ṣalātī wa nusukī wa maḥyāya wa mamātī lillāhi rabbi al-'ālamīna lā sharīka lahu
en: Say: Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of all the worlds; He has no partner.
Indeed, then you would be among the wrongdoers.
Then indeed you would be among the wrongdoers.
I would then indeed be in clear error.
I would then indeed be among the wrongdoers.
Indeed, then you would certainly be losers.
Indeed, then you would be like them.
Indeed, then we would certainly be losers.
Indeed, then we would certainly be wrongdoers.
Indeed, then we would certainly be among the sinners.
Indeed, then we would certainly be among the wrongdoers.

tr: Innā idhan lafī ḍalālin wa su'urin
en: Indeed, then we would be in error and madness.
That then would be a losing return.
And how evil is the final destination!
And how evil is the resting place!
How evil is the resting place!
And how evil is the abode of the wrongdoers!
And how evil indeed is the companion!
How evil is the abode of the arrogant!
How evil indeed is the protector!

tr: Wa ma'wāhum jahannamu wa bi'sa al-maṣīru
en: And their refuge is Hell — and how evil is the final destination!

tr: Ma'wāhumu al-nāru wa bi'sa mathwā al-ẓālimīna
en: Their refuge is the Fire — and how evil is the abode of the wrongdoers!

tr: Wa ma'wāhumu al-nāru wa labi'sa al-maṣīru
en: And their refuge is the Fire — and how evil indeed is the final destination!

ar: مَأْوَاكُمُ الَنَّارُ هِيَ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
tr: Ma'wākumu al-nāru hiya mawlākum wa bi'sa al-maṣīru
en: Your refuge is the Fire; it is your master — and how evil is the final destination!

ar: أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْحِسَابِ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
tr: Ulā'ika lahum sū'u al-ḥisābi wa ma'wāhum jahannamu wa bi'sa al-mihādu
en: Those — for them is an evil reckoning and their refuge is Hell — and how evil is the resting place!

ar: ضَرُّهُ أَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِ لَبِئْسَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ الْعَشِيرُ
tr: Ḍarruhu aqrabu min naf'ihi labi'sa al-mawlā wa labi'sa al-'ashīru
en: Its harm is closer than its benefit. How evil indeed is the protector and how evil the companion!
And how excellent is the Trustee!
How excellent are the ones who are able!
And how excellent is the reward of those who work! | And excellent is the reward of the workers
Allah is sufficient for us, and how excellent is the Trustee!

ar: أَنَّ الَلَّهَ مَوْلَاكُمْ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ الَنَّصِيرُ
tr: Anna Allāha mawlākum ni'ma al-mawlā wa ni'ma al-naṣīru
en: That Allah is your protector — how excellent is the Protector and how excellent is the Helper!

ar: هُوَ مَوْلَاكُمْ فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ الَنَّصِيرُ
tr: Huwa mawlākum fani'ma al-mawlā wa ni'ma al-naṣīru
en: He is your protector — how excellent is the Protector and how excellent is the Helper!

ar: وَلَدَارُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ
tr: Wa ladāru al-ākhirati khayrun wa lani'ma dāru al-muttaqīna
en: And the home of the Hereafter is indeed better — and how excellent is the home of the righteous!
No! Indeed, it is a reminder
No! Indeed, it is a word he is speaking
No! Indeed, with me is my Lord
No! Indeed, he has been stubborn towards Our verses
No! Indeed, it is the Blazing Fire

ar: كَلَّا بَلْ هُوَ الَلَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
en: No! Rather, He is Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

ar: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
tr: kalla inna kitabal fujjari lafi sijjin
en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in Sijjeen

ar: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyyeen

tr: wa ma adraka ma yawmud din
en: And what can make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

tr: wa ma adraka ma yawmul fasl
en: And what can make you know what the Day of Decision is?

tr: wa ma adraka ma laylatul qadr
en: And what can make you know what the Night of Decree is?
And what can make you know what the Striking Calamity is?
And what can make you know what the Inevitable Reality is?
And what can make you know what the Night Visitant is?
And what can make you know what Sijjeen is?
And what can make you know what Saqar is?
And what can make you know what the difficult pass is?
And what can make you know what 'Illiyyoon is?

ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ. لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
tr: wa ma adraka ma laylatul qadr. laylatul qadri khayrum min alfi shahr
en: And what can make you know what the Night of Decree is? The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months

ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الَدِّينِ. ثُمَّ مَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الَدِّينِ
tr: wa ma adraka ma yawmud din. thumma ma adraka ma yawmud din
en: And what can make you know what the Day of Recompense is? Then, what can make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

ar: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ. وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ. كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ. وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: kalla inna kitabal fujjari lafi sijjin. wa ma adraka ma sijjin. kitabum marqum. waylun yawma'idhil lilmukadhdhibin
en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in Sijjeen. And what can make you know what Sijjeen is? It is a written record. Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ar: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ. وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ. كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
tr: kalla inna kitabal abrari lafi 'illiyyin. wa ma adraka ma 'illiyyun. kitabum marqum
en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyyeen. And what can make you know what 'Illiyyoon is? It is a written record.

ar: الْقَارِعَةُ. مَا الْقَارِعَةُ. وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ
tr: al qari'ah. mal qari'ah. wa ma adraka mal qari'ah
en: The Striking Calamity! What is the Striking Calamity? And what can make you know what the Striking Calamity is?

ar: الْحَاقَّةُ. مَا الْحَاقَّةُ. وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ
tr: al haqqah. mal haqqah. wa ma adraka mal haqqah
en: The Inevitable Reality! What is the Inevitable Reality? And what can make you know what the Inevitable Reality is?
Then indeed, sufficient for you is Allah
Then He is sufficient for him
O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allah
Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs
Then sufficient for him is Hell, and wretched is the resting place

ar: فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ إِنَّ الَلَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ
en: Then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose

ar: فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ الَلَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: faqul hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huw
en: Then say, 'Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him'
And Allah is most knowing of the wrongdoers
And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters
And He is most knowing of the rightly guided

tr: inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu bil mu'tadin
en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of the transgressors
Allah is most knowing of what is within themselves
And Allah is most knowing of your faith

ar: وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِي الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
tr: wa rabbuka a'lamu biman fis samawati wal ard
en: And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth
And to Allah is the final destination
And to Him is the final destination
And to Us is the final destination
And to Me is the final destination

ar: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
tr: la ilaha illa huwa ilaihil masir
en: There is no deity except Him; to Him is the final destination
To Him is your return all together
Then to their Lord is their return | then to their Lord is their return
Then to your Lord is your return
Then to Us is your return
Then indeed, their return is to the Hellfire

ar: مَتَاعٌ فِي الَدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ
tr: mata'un fid dunya thumma ilaina marji'uhum
en: [It is but a brief] enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return

ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ الَسَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى الَلَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ
tr: wa lillahi mulkus samawati wal ardi wa ilallahil masir
en: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the final destination

ar: إِلَى الَلَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tr: ilallahi marji'ukum wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadir
en: To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent
And who is better in religion
And who is better in speech
And who is better than Allah in judgment
And who is better than Allah in religion/dye
And who is more truthful than Allah in statement
which of you is best in deed
which of them is best in deed
which of us is more severe in punishment
He is stronger than them in might
they were greater than them in strike

ar: أَ أَنْتُمْ / أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا / أَمِ الَسَّمَاءُ
tr: a antum ashaddu khalqan amis sama'
en: Are you more difficult to create or is the heaven?

ar: هُوَ / أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قُوَّةً / وَأَكْثَرُ جَمْعًا
tr: huwa ashaddu minhu quwwatan wa aktharu jam'an
en: He was stronger than him in might and greater in multitude
The fire of Hell is more intense in heat
The bedouins are stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy
so they are like stones or even harder in heart
it was stronger in might than your city
Who is stronger than us in might?
We are more in wealth and children

tr: wallahu ashaddu ba'san wa ashaddu tankilan
en: And Allah is greater in might and stronger in punishment
That is best and most suitable for determination/outcome

ar: فَالَلَّهُ / خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا / وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الَرَّاحِمِينَ
tr: fallahu khayrun hafithan wa huwa arhamur rahimin
en: But Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful

ar: وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الَصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ / عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا / وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا
tr: wal baqiyatus salihatu khayrun 'inda rabbika thawaban wa khayrun amalan
en: And the enduring good deeds are better with your Lord for reward and better for hope

ar: وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الَصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ / عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا / وَخَيْرٌ مَرَدًّا
tr: wal baqiyatus salihatu khayrun 'inda rabbika thawaban wa khayrun maraddan
en: And the enduring good deeds are better with your Lord for reward and better for return

ar: أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ / يَوْمَئِذٍ / خَيْرٌ مُسْتَقَرًّا / وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
tr: ashabul jannati yawma'idhin khayrun mustaqarran wa ahsanu maqilan
en: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are better in abode and better in resting place
For them therein is the home of eternity as reward

tr: innahum rijsun wa ma'wahum jahannamu jaza'an
en: Indeed, they are unclean, and their refuge is Hell as recompense
and their refuge is Hell as recompense
Then indeed, Hell is your recompense as a sufficient reward

ar: ذَلِكَ جَزَاءُ أَعْدَاءِ الَلَّهِ / الَنَّارُ / لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ / جَزَاءً
tr: dhalika jaza'u a'da'illahin naru lahum fiha darul khuldi jaza'an
en: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense
He sends over you guardian angels
He sends the wind upon you
And He sends the thunder praising Him
And We did not send you except as a mercy
Indeed We have sent you as a witness
And We sent to them messengers
He will give them their rewards
He will soon admit them to Paradise
We will show them Our signs
I will punish them with a severe punishment
He who fears will soon take heed

tr: wa sawfa yu'tiika rabbuka fa tardaa
en: And your Lord will give you, and you will be satisfied

tr: wa man yaghfiru dh-dhunooba illaa Allaahu
en: And who forgives sins except Allah?
He forgives what is below that (shirk)
And He is the One Who forgives sins

tr: wa Allaahu yaghfiru li man yashaa'u
en: And Allah forgives whom He wills
And He forgives the evil deeds

tr: rabbi ghfir lii wa li waalidayya
en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents

tr: wa inna rabbaka la dhuu maghfiratin
en: And your Lord is surely the possessor of forgiveness
And seek forgiveness from your Lord
And Allah knows what you do
And Allah has knowledge of all things
He knows what is before them
Indeed Allah loves those who do good
And He does not love the disbelievers

ar: إِنَّ اللهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
tr: inna Allaaha ya'lamu wa antum laa ta'lamuun
en: Indeed Allah knows and you do not know
He knows your secrets and what you declare
He loves them and they love Him
Indeed Allah loves those who repent

tr: wa Allaahu ya'lamu l-mufsidina mina l-muslihiin
en: And Allah knows the corrupters from the reformers
And Allah guides whom He wills
And He gives life and causes death
They want to extinguish the light of Allah
And He is the One who gives life
He will cause you to die, then He will bring you to life

tr: wa Allaahu laa yahdii l-qawma z-zaalimiin
en: And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

ar: يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
tr: yahdii man yashaa'u ilaa siraatin mustaqiim
en: He guides whom He wills to a straight path
And He gives life to the earth after its death

tr: wa Allaahu yahkumu laa mu'aqqiba lihukmih
en: And Allah judges, there is no adjuster of His ruling

tr: wa maa Allaahu yuriidu zulman lil-'aalamiin
en: And Allah does not want injustice for the worlds
He believes in Allah and the Last Day
And your Lord does not wrong anyone
They say, 'Our Lord, we have believed'
He creates you in the wombs of your mothers
He disbelieves in the Most Merciful
He disputes concerning the signs of Allah
He fears neither injustice nor deprivation
Can there be a treaty for the polytheists?
Mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds
It is thought that they will be resurrected
Allah created the heavens and the earth

ar: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِي أَعْطَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
tr: qaala rabbunaa lladhii a'taa kulla shay'in
en: He said: Our Lord is He who gave everything
He sent His Messenger with guidance
And He made the darkness and the light
He remembered the name of his Lord and prayed
And We have certainly honored the children of Adam | And certainly We have honored the children of Adam
He has certainly succeeded who purifies it
And he has failed who instills it with corruption
Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?
So as for the orphan, do not oppress him
Say: He is Allah, the One
Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak
Recite in the name of your Lord
And seek help through patience and prayer
And fulfil the covenant of Allah
So remember Me; I will remember you
And repent to Allah, all of you
Our Lord, give us in this world good
And protect us from the torment of the Fire
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
tr: wa nahnu aqrabu ilayhi min hablil-wariid
en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein

ar: مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth

tr: wa maa min ilahin illaa Allaahu
en: And there is no deity except Allah
Indeed Allah is with the patient
And exalt with praise of your Lord
And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together
Indeed to your Lord is the return
And He is over all things competent
And to Allah belongs what is in the heavens
From it are verses that are precise
The blessing of Allah upon you
The mercy of Allah and His blessings
The promise of Allah is true
The punishment of Allah is severe
The bounty of Allah is great

ar: إِنَّ عِدَّةَ الشُّهُورِ عِنْدَ اللهِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ
en: Indeed the number of months in the sight of Allah is twelve
Indeed Allah has been All-Knowing, All-Wise
Indeed Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful
Indeed You are the All-Knowing, the All-Wise
Indeed the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam
As if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees
So that you may become righteous
So that they may be reminded
That Allah is the manifest truth
Indeed your enemy is the one cut off
Indeed Allah has purchased from the believers

ar: إِنَّ اللهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
en: Indeed Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of the doers of good
There is no god but Allah

ar: لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
tr: laa khawfun 'alayhim wa laa hum yahzanuun
en: No fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve
You will never attain righteousness until you spend
He neither begets nor is He begotten
Muhammad is not the father of any of your men

ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
tr: laa yukallifu Allaahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa
en: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear

tr: laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa laa nawm
en: Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep

ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
tr: maa lakum laa tarjuuna lillaahi waqaaran
en: What is the matter with you that you do not attribute to Allah due grandeur?
None touch it except the purified
And I am not of the polytheists
If you love Allah, then follow me
When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest
And if you return, We will return

ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللهُ لَفَسَدَتَا
tr: law kaana fiihimaa aalihatun illaa Allaahu lafasadataa
en: Had there been gods in them other than Allah, they would have been ruined

ar: إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
tr: idhaa qadaa amran fa-innamaa yaquulu lahu kun fayakuun
en: When He decrees a matter, He only says to it: Be! And it is
If she returns, then make reconciliation
If you help Allah (His cause), He will help you

ar: لَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى جَبَلٍ
en: If We had sent down this Quran upon a mountain
When the sun is wrapped up

ar: إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا
tr: in tatubaa ilallaahi faqad saghat quluubukumaa
en: If you both repent to Allah, your hearts have already inclined
If you seek forgiveness, He will forgive you
And when you recite the Quran, seek refuge with Allah
By the sun and its brightness
By the night when it covers
By the morning brightness and the night when it is still
By the star when it descends
By the fig and the olive
By time, indeed mankind is in loss
By the sky and the night comer
I swear by the Day of Resurrection
By the sky containing great stars
By the soul and He who proportioned it
So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
And in part of the night, glorify Him

ar: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ
tr: inna fii khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi wakh-tilaafil-layli wan-nahaar
en: Indeed in the creation of the heavens and earth and the alternation of night and day
By the day when it appears

ar: وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ
tr: wa sabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla tuluu'ish-shamsi
en: And exalt with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun
And in part of the night, pray with it (the Quran)

ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا
tr: yawma laa tamliku nafsun linafsin shay'an
en: A Day when no soul will avail another soul in anything

ar: وَلِلَّهِ الْأَمْرُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَمِنْ بَعْدُ
tr: wa lillaahil-amru min qablu wa min ba'd
en: And to Allah belongs the matter before and after

ar: اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
en: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence
And Allah is witness over what you do

ar: هُوَ اللهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: huwallaahu lladhii laa ilaaha illaa huw
en: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity
The truth is from your Lord
And Allah of what you do is Seeing
Exalted is your Lord, Lord of might
The King, the Pure, the Giver of Peace

ar: إِنَّ اللهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ
en: Indeed it is Allah who is the provider, the firm possessor of strength
Is not Allah sufficient for His servant?
Has there come to you the report of the Overwhelming Event?

ar: مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ
en: Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission?
Wherever you may be, death will overtake you
How can you disbelieve in Allah?
Then will you not be reminded?
Did We not expand for you your chest?
Have they not traveled through the earth?
Is the reward for good other than good?
Then which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Does he not know that Allah sees?

ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
tr: rabbana laa tuzigh quluubanaa ba'da idh hadaytanaa
en: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us
My Lord, increase me in knowledge
My Lord, expand for me my chest
Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers

ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ
tr: rabbana hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa dhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yun
en: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort of eyes

ar: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ
en: My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the incitements of the devils

ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا
tr: rabbana innanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa dhunuubanaa
en: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins
My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer

ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
tr: rabbana taqabbal minnaa innaka anta s-samii'ul-'aliim
en: Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing

ar: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا
tr: rabbana atimm lanaa nuuranaa waghfir lanaa
en: Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us

ar: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ
tr: rabbi adkhilnii mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijnii mukhraja sidqin
en: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and exit a sound exit

ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
tr: allaahumma salli 'alaa muhammadin wa 'alaa aali muhammad
en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad

ar: إِنَّ اللهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ
en: Indeed Allah and His angels send blessing upon the Prophet

ar: وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ
tr: wa maa ya'lamu junuuda rabbika illaa huw
en: And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him

ar: وَإِنْ تَصْبِرُوا وَتَتَّقُوا لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا
tr: wa in tasbiruu wa tattaquu laa yadhurrukum kayduhum shay'an
en: And if you are patient and fear Allah, their plot will not harm you at all

tr: alladhiina yu'minuuna bil-ghaybi wa yuqiimuuna s-salaata
en: Those who believe in the unseen and establish prayer

tr: yawma tabyaddhu wujuuhun wa taswaddu wujuuh
en: On the Day when faces will turn white and faces will turn black

ar: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
tr: faman ya'mal mithqaala dharratin khayran yarah
en: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it

ar: وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
tr: wa man ya'mal mithqaala dharratin sharran yarah
en: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it

ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللهَ وَكُونُوا مَعَ الصَّادِقِينَ
tr: yaa ayyuhal-ladhiina aamanuu ittaqullaaha wa kuunuu ma'as-saadiqiin
en: O you who have believed, fear Allah and be with the truthful

tr: wa man yu'min billaahi yahdi qalbah
en: And whoever believes in Allah, He guides his heart

ar: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ
en: Indeed prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing
And the remembrance of Allah is greater

ar: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tr: qul inna salaatii wa nusukii wa mahyaaya wa mamaatii lillaahi rabbil-'aalamiin
en: Say: Indeed my prayer, my rites, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds
Allah created the heavens and the earth

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللهَ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ
tr: Alam tara anna Allaaha khalaqa as-samaawaati wal-ard
en: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth

ar: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا
tr: Huwa alladhee khalaqa lakum maa fil-ardi jamee'aa
en: He is the One who created for you everything that is in the earth
Blessed is He who created all creation
Glory be to Him who created all pairs

ar: مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً
tr: Man khalaqa as-samaawaati wal-arda wa-anzala lakum minas-samaai maa'aa
en: Who created the heavens and the earth and sent down water for you from the sky

ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ
tr: Al-hamdu lillaahi alladhee khalaqa as-samaawaati wal-ard
en: All praise is for Allah who created the heavens and the earth
And he strove in the path of Allah
Whoever believed in Allah and the Last Day
And Allah sent down upon you the Book and Wisdom

ar: مَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَ بِآيَاتِ اللهِ
en: Who is more unjust than one who denied the signs of Allah

ar: قَالَ مُوسَى لِقَوْمِهِ اسْتَعِينُوا بِاللهِ وَاصْبِرُوا
tr: Qaala Moosaa liqawmihi ista'eenoo billaahi waasbiroo
en: Musa said to his people: Seek help from Allah and be patient
Indeed those who believed and did righteous deeds

ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ
tr: Innal-ladheena kafaroo sawaa'un 'alayhim a-andhartahum am lam tundhirhum
en: Indeed those who disbelieved — it is all the same to them whether you warn them or do not warn them

ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ
en: O you who believed! Fear Allah as He deserves to be feared
And they took gods besides Allah

ar: الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللهِ
en: Those who disbelieved and turned others away from the path of Allah
Those are the ones who purchased misguidance in exchange for guidance
And those who believed are stronger in love for Allah

ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَهَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ
tr: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa-haajaroo wa-jaahadoo bi-amwaalihim wa-anfusihim
en: Indeed those who believed and emigrated and strove with their wealth and their lives
Do not be like those who disbelieved

ar: قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
tr: Qaaloo innaa lillaahi wa-innaa ilayhi raaji'oon
en: They said: Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we will return

ar: فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَنْ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللهُ
en: So they sought forgiveness for their sins — and who forgives sins except Allah
Indeed We have made it an Arabic Quran

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ
en: And We made from water every living thing

ar: وَكَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِيهَا أَنَّ النَّفْسَ بِالنَّفْسِ
en: And We decreed for them therein that a life for a life
Indeed We sent it down on the Night of Decree

ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الْقِبْلَةَ الَّتِي كُنْتَ عَلَيْهَا إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ
en: And We did not make the qiblah which you used to face except to distinguish

ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Innaa kunnaa nastansikhu maa kuntum ta'maloon
en: Indeed We have been recording what you were doing

ar: أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
en: What — when we have become bones and crumbled dust, will we really be resurrected
And thus We have revealed it as an Arabic judgment
And We certainly gave Musa the Book
Indeed We used to call upon Him before
So We made them leaders guiding by Our command
Did you disbelieve after your faith?

ar: أَرَأَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ
en: Have you all considered what you call upon besides Allah?
And Allah is All-Aware of what you all used to do.

ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ لَاتَّبَعْتُمُ الشَّيْطَانَ
en: And if not for Allah's grace upon you, you would have all followed Shaytan.
Or have you all taken protectors besides Him?

ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَاعًا فَاسْأَلُوهُنَّ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ
tr: wa idhaa sa-altumoo hunna mataa'an fas-aloohunna min waraa-i hijaab
en: And when you ask them for something, ask them from behind a screen.
You all are the best nation ever raised for mankind.

ar: وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ
tr: wa maa kuntum tastatiroona an yashhada 'alaykum sam'ukum
en: And you did not hide yourselves lest your own hearing should testify against you.
So repent to your Creator and slay yourselves (as commanded expiation).
I did not worship what you worship
Say: Indeed I have been commanded
And I was of the wrongdoers
Indeed I was of the Muslims
My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself
My Lord, indeed the bone has become weak in me
Indeed I know what you do not know
Indeed I have made you a leader for the people

ar: إِذَا رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِي آيَاتِنَا
tr: idhaa ra-ayta alladhiina yakhuudhuuna fii aayaatinaa
en: When you see those who delve into Our verses
Whether you warn them or you do not warn them

ar: لَوْ أَنْفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا
en: Even if you spent everything that is in the earth

ar: مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ
tr: maa mana'aka allaa tasjuda idh amartuka
en: What prevented you from prostrating when I commanded you?
Did you not see how your Lord dealt?
And if the truth were to follow their desires

ar: مَا كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُهَا أَنْتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ
tr: maa kunta ta'lamuha anta wa-laa qawmuka
en: You did not know it, nor did your people

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ
tr: alam tara ilaa rabbika kayfa maddaz-zilla
en: Did you not see how your Lord extended the shade?
Have you considered the one who denies the Day of Judgment?

ar: قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَكَ هَذَا الَّذِي كَرَّمْتَ عَلَيَّ
en: He said: Do you see this one whom You have honoured above me?

ar: قُلْ لِمَ كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ
en: Say: Why did you disbelieve in the signs of Allah?
Then you turned away after that
Then a group from the Children of Israel believed
The people of Noah denied the messengers

ar: وَجَاءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
tr: wa-jaa-at kullu nafsin ma'ahaa saa-iqun wa-shaheed
en: And every soul will come — with it a driver and a witness
And your people denied it while it is the truth
What it sent forward and what it left behind
And the Jews said: The hand of Allah is chained
Certainly, laws/examples have passed before you
And what your right hands possess
And had earned good in its faith
And when the word (decree) falls upon them
When the sky is split apart
And his sin had surrounded him
And what was sent down before you
When the Quran was revealed to them

ar: لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ
en: Why was not a sign sent down upon him from his Lord?
When Allah is mentioned, their hearts tremble
And when it is said to them: Fear Allah

ar: وَلَقَدْ خُلِقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ
tr: wa-laqad khalaqnal-insaana wa-na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihi nafsuh
en: And We have certainly created man and know what his soul whispers to him
It is said (to them): Enter Paradise
And had it not been for a word already preceded from your Lord

ar: الَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ
tr: alladheena ukhrijoo min diyaarihim bi-ghayri haqq
en: Those who were driven out of their homes without right
Those who were given the Book before you

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيبًا مِنَ الْكِتَابِ
tr: alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseebam minal-kitaab
en: Have you not seen those who were given a portion of the Book?
And certainly those before them were tried/tested
Those who were harmed in the path of Allah
And when they are mentioned, they are not arrogant
And you have been given of knowledge only a little
Certainly Moses was sent with Our signs
Those are the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor
What they were put through in the path of Allah

ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمُ ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: And it was said to them: Enter Paradise for what you used to do

ar: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى الْهُدَى
en: And if Allah had willed, He would have gathered them all upon guidance
Were it not for the grace of Allah upon you and His mercy

ar: وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّ اللهَ عَلِيمٌ بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ
en: And if they turn away, then indeed Allah is knowing of the corrupters
That is because they disbelieved and used to transgress

ar: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا
en: Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times its equal
And certainly they were patient over what they were denied
Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed

ar: وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا
tr: wa-man jaa-a bis-sayyi-ati falaa yujzaa illaa mithlahaa
en: And whoever comes with an evil deed will only be recompensed its equal

ar: لَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَآمَنَ مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ
tr: law shaa-a rabbuka la-aamana man fil-ardi kulluhum
en: If your Lord had willed, all those on earth would have believed
And seeking the pleasure of Allah
